 for record in WATCHDOG_V22_WRAPPER_PHYSICAL_RECORDS:
  if record.record_id in domain:
   offset=watchdog_v23_transient_offset(record)
   rows.append((record.record_id,WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED[offset],
    WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]))
 return tuple(rows)

def v25_probe_never_live_census(context):
 need(context.get(b"v22_completed_probe_count",0)==0)
 need(context.get(b"v23_completed_probe_count",0)==0)
 need(context.get(b"v22_probe_induction_trace",())==())
 need(context.get(b"v23_probe_induction_trace",())==())
 for record in v25_probe_base_records(context):
  need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1 and record.epoch==0)
 need(not v25_probe_poller_rows(context))
 return (b"V25_NONE_NEVER_LIVE_CENSUS",tuple(record.record_id for record in v25_probe_base_records(context)))

def v25_probe_state_census(context):
 base=tuple((record.record_id,record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,record.state,
  record.raw_fd,record.epoch,record.identity,record.physical_identity,record.access,
  record.provenance,record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.raw_cell.state,
  record.raw_cell.c_value.value,record.raw_cell.epoch) for record in v25_probe_base_records(context))
 transient=tuple((record.record_id,record.state,record.raw_fd,record.epoch,
  record.identity,record.physical_identity,record.access,record.provenance,
  record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.raw_cell.state,
  record.raw_cell.c_value.value,record.raw_cell.epoch) for record in v25_probe_transient_records(context))
 return (b"V25_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS",base,transient,
  v25_probe_poller_rows(context),v25_probe_reconciliation_rows(context))

def v25_proof_digest(proof):
 need(type(proof)is tuple and proof[0]==V25_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG)
 raw=repr(proof).encode("ascii")
 return sha(b"P27_E001_V25_PROBE_PROOF\x00"+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\n"+raw)

def v25_verify_probe_proved(context,state,expected_ordinal=None):
 need(type(state)is tuple and len(state)==3 and state[0]==V25_PROBE_PROVED)
 proof,digest=state[1:]
 need(type(proof)is tuple and len(proof)==17 and proof[0]==V25_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG)
 need(type(digest)is bytes and len(digest)==64 and v25_proof_digest(proof)==digest)
 ordinal,probe,completed=proof[1:4]
 need(type(ordinal)is int and 0<=ordinal<15 and probe==PROBES[ordinal] and completed==ordinal+1)
 if expected_ordinal is not None:need(ordinal==expected_ordinal)
 need(context.get(b"v25_owner_authority") is WATCHDOG_V25_OWNER_AUTHORITY)
 need(WATCHDOG_V25_OWNER_AUTHORITY.state is state)
 return proof

def begin_probe_authority(context,ordinal,probe):
 need(type(ordinal)is int and 0<=ordinal<15 and probe==PROBES[ordinal])
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);prior=owner.state
 if ordinal==0:
  need(prior[0]==V25_NONE);v25_probe_never_live_census(context)
  previous_proof=None;prior_digest=b"GENESIS";prior_history=()
 else:
  previous_proof=v25_verify_probe_proved(context,prior,ordinal-1)
  prior_digest=prior[2];prior_history=previous_proof[14]
  completed=previous_proof[3];facts=previous_proof[6];outer_capture=previous_proof[4]
  need(completed==ordinal and outer_capture[1]==previous_proof[5][1])
  context[b"v22_completed_probe_count"]=completed
  context[b"v23_completed_probe_count"]=completed
  context[b"last_outer_pidfd_causal_facts"]=facts
  context[b"offer_snapshot_outer_fd"]=-1
  context[b"v22_last_proved_turnover"]=(b"V22_PROBE_TURNOVER_FROZEN",
   ordinal-1,facts,-1,outer_capture[1],b"PROVED_CLOSED")
 census=v25_probe_state_census(context)
 history=prior_history+((ordinal,b"V25_BEGIN_PROBE_AUTHORITY_FIRST",prior_digest,census),)
 owner.state=(V25_PROBE_ARMING,ordinal,probe,previous_proof,
  b"BEGIN_BEFORE_ANY_FALLIBLE_PROBE_WORK",None,census,history)
 return owner.state

def v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,stage,state=V25_PROBE_ARMING):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);current=owner.state
 need(current[0] in (V25_PROBE_ARMING,V25_PROBE_ARMED))
 requested=(V25_PROBE_ARMED if state in (V25_PROBE_ARMED,V24_PROBE_ARMED) else V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 need(requested in (V25_PROBE_ARMING,V25_PROBE_ARMED))
 census=v25_probe_state_census(context)
 history=current[7]+((current[1],stage,census),)
 owner.state=(requested,current[1],current[2],current[3],stage,current[5],census,history)
 return owner.state

v24_refresh_probe_authority=v25_refresh_probe_authority

def promote_lifecycle_fd(context,old_slot,new_slot,new_kind,transferable=False,provenance=None):
 frame=context.get(b"v19_pending_receive_frame");source=context[b"fd_registry"][old_slot]
 if not watchdog_record_live_v19(source) and frame is not None:source=frame.record_for_expected(old_slot)
 spec=watchdog_role_spec_v19(new_slot)
 need(watchdog_record_live_v19(source) and spec[1]==new_kind and spec[2]==bool(transferable))
 need(source.semantic_role==old_slot)
 need(not any(record is not source and watchdog_record_live_v19(record) and record.semantic_role==new_slot for record in WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19))
 frame_binding=None
 if frame is not None and frame.record_for_expected(old_slot,required=False) is source:
  frame_binding=(frame.site,frame.epoch,old_slot,source.record_id)
 prepared_provenance=provenance if provenance is not None else source.provenance
 need(prepared_provenance is not None)
 lifecycle_bind_identity_v19(source);need(lifecycle_live_number_owner(context,source.raw_fd,old_slot) in (None,old_slot))
 for record in WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19:
  if record is not source and watchdog_record_live_v19(record):need(record.raw_fd!=source.raw_fd)
 promoted_provenance=(b"PROMOTED",prepared_provenance,frame_binding,source.epoch)
 source.provenance=promoted_provenance
 source.semantic_role=new_slot
 if new_slot==b"outer_pidfd":
  owner=v25_owner_authority(context);current=owner.state
  need(current[0]==V25_PROBE_ARMING and current[2]==PROBES[current[1]])
  capture=(b"V25_OUTER_PIDFD_PROMOTION_CAPTURE",source.record_id,source.home_slot,
   old_slot,new_slot,new_kind,source.raw_fd,source.identity,source.physical_identity,
   source.access,promoted_provenance,source.epoch,frame_binding)
  need(source.identity==source.physical_identity and source.physical_identity is not None)
  owner.state=(current[0],current[1],current[2],current[3],
   b"OUTER_PIDFD_CAPTURED_AT_SEMANTIC_PROMOTION_BOUNDARY",capture,
   current[6],current[7]+((current[1],b"OUTER_PIDFD_CAPTURE",capture),))
 source.state=b"OWNED"
 if frame_binding is not None:frame.mark_promoted(old_slot,source.record_id)
 return source.raw_fd

def stream_arm(control,context,ordinal,probe):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);need(owner.state[0]==V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 need(owner.state[1:3]==(ordinal,probe))
 v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"ENTER_STREAM_BASE_ALL_FALLIBLE_STEPS",V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 try:result=V25_STREAM_ARM_BASE(control,context,ordinal,probe)
 except BaseException:
  v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"STREAM_ERROR_RETAINED_BY_PROBE_AUTHORITY",V25_PROBE_ARMING)
  raise
 v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"STREAM_WORK_COMPLETE_PROBE_OWNED",V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 return result

def pidfd_arm(control,context,ordinal,probe):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);need(owner.state[0]==V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 need(owner.state[1:3]==(ordinal,probe))
 v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"ENTER_CAPTURED_PIDFD_BASE_ALL_FALLIBLE_STEPS",V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 try:result=V25_PIDFD_ARM_BASE(control,context,ordinal,probe)
 except BaseException:
  v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"PIDFD_ERROR_RETAINED_BY_PROBE_AUTHORITY",V25_PROBE_ARMING)
  raise
 current=owner.state
 need(current[5] is not None and current[5][0]==b"V25_OUTER_PIDFD_PROMOTION_CAPTURE")
 v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"ALL_PROBE_ROLES_ARMED",V25_PROBE_ARMED)
 return result

def v25_close_probe_records(context):
 bases=v25_probe_base_records(context)
 for record in bases:
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED":v24_close_one_probe_record(context,record)
 for base in bases:
  while watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(base):
   outcome=watchdog_v24_drain_new_mismatches(context,base)
   if outcome!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:WATCHDOG_CLOSURE_WAIT_V19.poll(10)
 transients=v25_probe_transient_records(context)
 for record in transients:
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED":watchdog_v22_close_transient(record)
 for record in bases:
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED":v24_close_one_probe_record(context,record)
 WATCHDOG_OUT_STREAM_V19.reset();WATCHDOG_ERR_STREAM_V19.reset()
 for record in bases+transients:
  need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
  record.raw_cell.state=b"DISARMED";record.raw_cell.c_value.value=-1
 for cell in WATCHDOG_MONITORED_FRAME_V19.raw_cells:
  need(cell.state in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED",b"RESOLVED_ALIAS",b"DETACHED",b"EFFECT_RESOLVED_BY_OBSERVATION"))
  cell.state=b"DISARMED";cell.c_value.value=-1
 return bases,transients

def v25_prepare_probe_proof(context,current):
 need(current[0]==V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 ordinal,probe=current[1:3];capture=current[5]
 need(capture is not None and capture[0]==b"V25_OUTER_PIDFD_PROMOTION_CAPTURE")
 bases,transients=v25_close_probe_records(context)
 base_ids={record.record_id for record in bases};transient_ids={record.record_id for record in transients}
 need(capture[1] in base_ids)
 outer=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[capture[1]]
 need(outer.state==b"CLOSED" and outer.raw_fd==-1 and outer.raw_cell.state==b"DISARMED")
 outer_receipt=(b"V25_EXACT_OUTER_PIDFD_CLOSURE_RECEIPT",capture[1],capture[7],
  capture[8],capture[9],capture[10],capture[11],b"CLOSED",-1,b"DISARMED")
 need(outer_receipt[1:7]==(capture[1],capture[7],capture[8],capture[9],capture[10],capture[11]))
 for record in bases:need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1 and record.raw_cell.state==b"DISARMED")
 for record in transients:need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1 and record.raw_cell.state==b"DISARMED")
 raw_rows=tuple((record.record_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value)
  for record in bases+transients)
 need(all(row[1]==b"DISARMED" and row[2]==-1 for row in raw_rows))
 poller_rows=v25_probe_poller_rows(context)
 need(all(row[1] in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") for row in poller_rows))
 reconciliation=v25_probe_reconciliation_rows(context)
 need(all((not row[1]) or row[2] is not None for row in reconciliation))
 census=v25_probe_state_census(context)
 live_states=(b"ACQUIRING",b"OWNED",b"CLOSE_RETRY")
 need(not any(row[3] in live_states or row[4]>=0 for row in census[1]))
 need(not any(row[1] in live_states or row[2]>=0 for row in census[2]))
 facts=(capture[10][1],bool(context.get(b"pidfd_exit_ready_observed")),
  context.get(b"outer_release_record_identity"),context.get(b"outer_pid"),context.get(b"outer_starttime"))
 need(type(facts[2])is tuple and len(facts[2])==3)
 context[b"offer_snapshot_outer_fd"]=-1
 completed=ordinal+1
 base_rows=tuple((record.record_id,record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,record.state,
  record.raw_fd,record.raw_cell.state,record.epoch) for record in bases)
 transient_rows=tuple((record.record_id,record.state,record.raw_fd,record.raw_cell.state,
  record.epoch,record.provenance) for record in transients)
 history=current[7]+((ordinal,b"V25_PROOF_PREPARED_WHILE_PROBE_ARMING",census),)
 proof=(V25_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG,ordinal,probe,completed,capture,outer_receipt,
  facts,base_rows,transient_rows,raw_rows,poller_rows,reconciliation,census,
  current[3],history,-1,b"ALL_EXHAUSTIVE_PREDICATES_TRUE")
 need(len(proof)==17)
 return proof

def v25_publish_probe_proved_nonfailing(context,owner,current,proof):
 need(owner.state is current and current[0]==V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 digest=v25_proof_digest(proof);completed=proof[3];facts=proof[6];capture=proof[4]
 context[b"last_outer_pidfd_causal_facts"]=facts
 context[b"offer_snapshot_outer_fd"]=proof[15]
 context[b"pidfd_bound"]=False;context[b"outer_pidfd_close_state"]=b"CLOSED_NORMAL"
 context[b"outer_pidfd_offer_state"]=b"NOT_BOUND";context[b"outer_offer_binding"]=None
 context[b"v22_completed_probe_count"]=completed;context[b"v23_completed_probe_count"]=completed
 context[b"v22_last_proved_turnover"]=(b"V22_PROBE_TURNOVER_FROZEN",proof[1],
  facts,proof[15],capture[1],b"PROVED_CLOSED")
 owner.state=(V25_PROBE_PROVED,proof,digest)
 return True

def v25_probe_close_driver(context):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);current=owner.state
 if current[0]==V25_PROBE_PROVED:v25_verify_probe_proved(context,current);return True
 need(current[0] in (V25_PROBE_ARMING,V25_PROBE_ARMED))
 if current[0]==V25_PROBE_ARMED:
  current=v25_refresh_probe_authority(context,b"CLOSE_PREPARATION_RETAINS_PROBE_AUTHORITY",V25_PROBE_ARMING)
 proof=v25_prepare_probe_proof(context,current)
 return v25_publish_probe_proved_nonfailing(context,owner,current,proof)

def v25_owner_closure_takeover_snapshot(context,prior,candidate):
 probe_live=tuple(record.record_id for record in v25_probe_base_records(context) if record.state!=b"CLOSED")
 transient_live=tuple(record.record_id for record in v25_probe_transient_records(context) if record.state!=b"CLOSED")
 poller_plan=v25_probe_poller_rows(context)
 reconciliation_plan=v25_probe_reconciliation_rows(context)
 closure_record_plan=tuple(candidate[6])
 need(set(probe_live+transient_live)<=set(closure_record_plan))
 return (b"V25_SOLE_CLOSURE_CELL_TAKEOVER_PLAN",prior,closure_record_plan,
  probe_live,transient_live,poller_plan,reconciliation_plan,v25_probe_state_census(context))

def v22_install_closure_candidate_assignment_only(context,cell,candidate):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);prior=owner.state
 need(prior[0] in (V25_NONE,V25_PROBE_ARMING,V25_PROBE_ARMED,V25_PROBE_PROVED))
 takeover=v25_owner_closure_takeover_snapshot(context,prior,candidate)
 V25_INSTALL_CLOSURE_BASE(context,cell,candidate)
 owner.state=(V25_OWNER_CLOSURE,cell,takeover,candidate)

def v25_takeover_owner_closure(context,acceptance_authority,deadline,offered):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context)
 if owner.state[0]==V25_OWNER_CLOSURE:return owner.state
 cell=context[b"v19_closure_cell"];need(cell.phase==b"NOT_STARTED")
 candidate=v22_prepare_closure_candidate(context,acceptance_authority,deadline,offered)
 need(candidate[0]==b"V22_COMPLETE_IMMUTABLE_CLOSURE_CANDIDATE")
 v22_install_closure_candidate_assignment_only(context,cell,candidate)
 need(owner.state[0]==V25_OWNER_CLOSURE and owner.state[1] is cell)
 return owner.state

def v25_owner_release_exhaustive(context,state):
 need(state[0]==V25_OWNER_CLOSURE and state[1].phase==b"RELEASED")
 need(ownership_capabilities_closed(context))
 need(context.get(b"v23_exhaustive_release_proof") is not None)
 need(all(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1 for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS))
 need(all(cell.state in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") for cell in WATCHDOG_POLLER_CELLS_V19))
 need(all((not row[1]) or row[2] is not None for row in v25_probe_reconciliation_rows(context)))
 return True

def v19_closure_driver(context,acceptance_authority=None,deadline=None,offered=None,probe_only=False):
 if probe_only:return close_probe(context)
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context)
 if owner.state[0]!=V25_OWNER_CLOSURE:
  v25_takeover_owner_closure(context,acceptance_authority,deadline,offered)
 state=owner.state;need(state[0]==V25_OWNER_CLOSURE)
 result=V25_NONPROBE_DRIVER_BASE(context,acceptance_authority,deadline,offered,False)
 need(owner.state is state and state[1].phase==b"RELEASED")
 v25_owner_release_exhaustive(context,state)
 return result

def close_probe(context):
 owner=v25_owner_authority(context);state=owner.state;mode=state[0]
 if mode in (V25_PROBE_ARMING,V25_PROBE_ARMED):return v25_probe_close_driver(context)
 if mode==V25_PROBE_PROVED:v25_verify_probe_proved(context,state);return True
 if mode==V25_OWNER_CLOSURE:
  phase=state[1].phase
  if phase in (b"ACTIVE",b"CLOSED"):
   return v19_closure_driver(context,None,None,None,False)
  need(phase==b"RELEASED");return v25_owner_release_exhaustive(context,state)
 need(mode==V25_NONE);v25_probe_never_live_census(context);return True

WATCHDOG_INTERNAL_REVISION_V25=b"V25"
WATCHDOG_V24_LIVE_CALLABLE_GRAPH_HISTORY=(b"HISTORICAL_NONCALLABLE_FAILED_PREDECESSOR",WATCHDOG_V24_LIVE_CALLABLE_GRAPH)
WATCHDOG_V24_LIVE_CALLABLE_GRAPH=(b"HISTORICAL_NONCALLABLE",b"SUPERSEDED_BY_WATCHDOG_V25_LIVE_CALLABLE_GRAPH")
WATCHDOG_V25_LIVE_CALLABLE_GRAPH=(
 (b"begin_probe_authority",begin_probe_authority),

 (b"promote_lifecycle_fd",promote_lifecycle_fd),
 (b"v19_closure_driver",v19_closure_driver),
 (b"close_probe",close_probe),(b"v25_probe_close_driver",v25_probe_close_driver),

)

class V26OwnerAuthority:
 __slots__=("state",)
 def __init__(self):
  self.state=(V26_NONE,b"NEVER_LIVE",(),None)

class V26CloseReceiptCell:
 __slots__=("record_id","state","epoch","bound","terminal")
 def __init__(self,record_id):
  self.record_id=record_id;self.state=b"EMPTY";self.epoch=0
  self.bound=None;self.terminal=None

 V26CloseReceiptCell(record.record_id) for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS
)

 WATCHDOG_MONITORED_FRAME_V19,WATCHDOG_EXTERNAL_CONTROL_FRAME_V19,
 WATCHDOG_EXTERNAL_RECEIPT_FRAME_V19,WATCHDOG_REFUSAL_FRAME_V19,
)

def v26_positive_wait():
 need(V26_EXTERNAL_SURVIVAL_POSITIVE_WAIT_PREMISE[0]==b"EXTERNAL_SURVIVAL")
 while True:
  try:WATCHDOG_CLOSURE_WAIT_V19.poll(10);return True
  except InterruptedError:continue

def v26_owner_authority(context):
 owner=context.get(b"v26_owner_authority")
 if owner is None:
  owner=WATCHDOG_V26_OWNER_AUTHORITY
  need(owner.state[0]==V26_NONE)
  context[b"v26_owner_authority"]=owner
 else:need(owner is WATCHDOG_V26_OWNER_AUTHORITY)
 need(type(owner.state)is tuple and owner.state[0] in V26_OWNER_MODES)
 return owner

def v26_record_row(record):
 return (record.record_id,record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,record.state,
  record.raw_fd,record.identity,record.physical_identity,record.leaf_identity,
  record.verified_kill_leaf_identity,record.access,record.provenance,record.epoch,
  record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.detached_raw_fd,
  record.wrapper_local_fallback,record.wrapper_probe_done,record.wrapper_detach_attempted,
  record.raw_cell.cell_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value,
  record.raw_cell.record_id,record.raw_cell.epoch,record.wrapper_ref is None)

def v26_raw_row(cell):
 return (cell.cell_id,cell.state,cell.c_value.value,cell.record_id,cell.epoch)

def v26_poller_row(cell):
 return (cell.cell_id,cell.state,cell.record_id,cell.raw_fd,cell.mask,cell.epoch)

def v26_frame_row(frame):
 return (frame.site,frame.semantic_capacity,frame.installed_capacity,
  frame.installed_count,frame.payload_count,frame.msg_flags,frame.capture_complete,
  frame.validation_complete,frame.capture_fault,frame.cleanup_cursor,
  frame.cleanup_pending,frame.epoch,tuple(v26_raw_row(cell) for cell in frame.raw_cells),
  tuple(record.record_id for record in frame.quarantine_records))

def v26_receipt_row(receipt):
 return (receipt.record_id,receipt.state,receipt.epoch,receipt.bound,receipt.terminal)

def v26_probe_domain_ids(context,capture=None,prior_ids=()):
 domain=set(prior_ids)
 for record in WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19:
  if record.home_slot in V26_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER or record.semantic_role in V26_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER:
   domain.add(record.record_id)
 if capture is not None:
  need(capture[0]==V26_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG);domain.add(capture[2])
 return tuple(sorted(domain))

def v26_probe_transient_ids(base_ids):
 rows=[]
 for record_id in base_ids:
  need(0<=record_id<len(WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19))
  for cell,record in WATCHDOG_V22_WRAPPER_MATRIX[record_id]:rows.append(record.record_id)
 need(len(rows)==len(set(rows)))
 return tuple(rows)

def v26_reconciliation_rows(transient_ids):
 rows=[]
 for record_id in transient_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  offset=watchdog_v23_transient_offset(record)
  rows.append((record_id,WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED[offset],
   WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]))
 return tuple(rows)

def v26_probe_state_census(context,capture=None,prior_ids=()):
 base_ids=v26_probe_domain_ids(context,capture,prior_ids)
 transient_ids=v26_probe_transient_ids(base_ids)
 base_rows=tuple(v26_record_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index]) for index in base_ids)
 transient_rows=tuple(v26_record_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index]) for index in transient_ids)
 raw_rows=tuple(v26_raw_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index].raw_cell)
  for index in base_ids+transient_ids)
 poller_rows=tuple(v26_poller_row(cell) for cell in WATCHDOG_POLLER_CELLS_V19
  if cell.record_id in set(base_ids+transient_ids))
 wrapper_rows=tuple((row[0],row[12],row[13],row[14],row[15],row[16],row[17])
  for row in base_rows+transient_rows)
 physical_live=tuple(v26_record_row(record) for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED" or record.raw_fd>=0)
 return (b"V26_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS",base_ids,transient_ids,base_rows,
  transient_rows,raw_rows,poller_rows,v26_reconciliation_rows(transient_ids),
  wrapper_rows,tuple(v26_frame_row(frame) for frame in WATCHDOG_V26_RECEIVE_FRAMES),
  physical_live,tuple(v26_receipt_row(receipt) for receipt in WATCHDOG_V26_CLOSE_RECEIPTS
   if receipt.record_id in set(base_ids+transient_ids)))

def v26_complete_closure_obligation_image(context,cell,candidate,prior):
 records=tuple(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS)
 record_rows=tuple(v26_record_row(record) for record in records)
 live_ids=tuple(record.record_id for record in records
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED" or record.raw_fd>=0)
 need(all(row[3]!=b"CLOSED" or row[4]==-1 for row in record_rows))
 plan=tuple(candidate[6]);need(candidate[7]==len(plan) and len(plan)==len(set(plan)))
 need(set(plan)==set(live_ids))
 raw_cells=tuple(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_RAW_CELLS)
 need(len({id(cell) for cell in raw_cells})==len(raw_cells))
 raw_rows=tuple(v26_raw_row(cell) for cell in raw_cells)
 result_rows=tuple(v26_raw_row(cell) for cell in WATCHDOG_V22_WRAPPER_RAW_CELLS)
 frame_rows=tuple(v26_frame_row(frame) for frame in WATCHDOG_V26_RECEIVE_FRAMES)
 poller_rows=tuple(v26_poller_row(cell) for cell in WATCHDOG_POLLER_CELLS_V19)
 reconciliation=tuple((record.record_id,)+v26_reconciliation_rows((record.record_id,))[0][1:]
  for record in WATCHDOG_V22_WRAPPER_PHYSICAL_RECORDS)
 wrapper_rows=tuple((record.record_id,record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,
  record.detached_raw_fd,record.wrapper_local_fallback,record.wrapper_probe_done,
  record.wrapper_detach_attempted,record.wrapper_ref is None) for record in records)
 commit=context[b"v19_acceptance_commit"]
 commit_row=(commit.state,commit.mode,commit.offer_sha,commit.record_seq,
  commit.predecessor,commit.receipt_sha,commit.outer_record_id,
  commit.outer_disposition,commit.no_replay,commit.commit_epoch,
  commit.candidate,commit.authority)
 return (V26_CLOSURE_IMAGE_TAG,cell,candidate,prior,live_ids,record_rows,
  tuple(record.record_id for record in records),raw_rows,result_rows,frame_rows,
  poller_rows,reconciliation,wrapper_rows,commit_row,
  tuple(v26_receipt_row(receipt) for receipt in WATCHDOG_V26_CLOSE_RECEIPTS),
  b"PLAN_EQUALS_EXACT_PHYSICAL_LIVE_SET",b"ENDPOINTS_LAST",
  V26_EXTERNAL_SURVIVAL_POSITIVE_WAIT_PREMISE)

def v26_reset_close_receipt(receipt,epoch):
 receipt.state=b"EMPTY";receipt.epoch=epoch;receipt.bound=None;receipt.terminal=None

def v26_prepare_record_close_receipt(record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V26_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 if receipt.epoch!=record.epoch:v26_reset_close_receipt(receipt,record.epoch)
 if receipt.state==b"EMPTY":
  need(record.state!=b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd>=0)
  bound=(b"V26_TYPED_RECORD_BOUND_CLOSE_RECEIPT",record.record_id,
   record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,record.raw_fd,record.identity,
   record.physical_identity,record.leaf_identity,record.access,record.provenance,
   record.epoch,record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.raw_cell.cell_id,
   record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value,record.raw_cell.epoch,
   record.wrapper_ref is None)
  terminal=(b"V26_TYPED_RECORD_CLOSE_EFFECT",record.record_id,record.epoch,
   b"CLOSED",-1,b"EMPTY",-1)
  receipt.bound=bound;receipt.terminal=terminal;receipt.state=b"CLOSE_ENTERED"
 else:
  need(receipt.state==b"CLOSE_ENTERED" and receipt.record_id==record.record_id)
  need(receipt.bound[1]==record.record_id and receipt.bound[10]==record.epoch)
 return receipt

def v26_finish_record_close_receipt(record,receipt):
 need(receipt.record_id==record.record_id and receipt.epoch==record.epoch)
 need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
 need(record.raw_cell.state==b"EMPTY" and record.raw_cell.c_value.value==-1)
 need(receipt.terminal==(b"V26_TYPED_RECORD_CLOSE_EFFECT",record.record_id,
  record.epoch,b"CLOSED",-1,b"EMPTY",-1))
 receipt.state=b"CLOSED_BOUND";return True

def lifecycle_mark_closed_v19(context,record):
 receipt=v26_prepare_record_close_receipt(record)
 result=V26_LIFECYCLE_MARK_CLOSED_BASE(context,record)
 v26_finish_record_close_receipt(record,receipt)
 return result

def close_lifecycle_record_v19(context,record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V26_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 if record.state==b"CLOSED":
  if receipt.epoch==record.epoch and receipt.state==b"CLOSE_ENTERED":
   v26_finish_record_close_receipt(record,receipt)
  return V23_CLOSE_PROVED
 need(record.raw_fd>=0);record.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY";number=record.raw_fd
 if watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(record):
  record.wrapper_phase=V23_MISMATCH_DRAIN_PENDING;return V23_NEED_TRANSIENT_DRAIN
 unregister_lifecycle_pollers_record_v19(record)
 wrapper_outcome=watchdog_endpoint_repair_v19(record)
 if wrapper_outcome in (V23_NEED_TRANSIENT_DRAIN,V23_SAFE_HOLD_POSITIVE_WAIT):return wrapper_outcome
 if record.identity is not None:
  try:lifecycle_bind_identity_v19(record)
  except OSError as probe:
   if probe.errno==errno.EBADF:
    v26_prepare_record_close_receipt(record)
    lifecycle_mark_closed_v19(context,record);return V23_CLOSE_PROVED
   raise OwnershipClosePending("v26-pre-close-revalidate") from probe
 v26_prepare_record_close_receipt(record)
 try:os.close(number)
 except OSError:
  try:lifecycle_bind_identity_v19(record)
  except OSError as probe:
   if probe.errno==errno.EBADF:
    lifecycle_mark_closed_v19(context,record);return V23_CLOSE_PROVED
   raise OwnershipClosePending("v26-close-probe-unknown") from probe
  record.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY";raise OwnershipClosePending("v26-close-live-retry")
 lifecycle_mark_closed_v19(context,record);return V23_CLOSE_PROVED
# P27 RUNNER V26 ATOMIC OWNER AND RECEIPT CELLS END 26A1C401

# P27 RUNNER V26 PROBE PREPARE COMMIT PROOF BEGIN 26B2D502
def v26_probe_never_live_census(context):
 owner=v26_owner_authority(context);need(owner.state[0]==V26_NONE)
 need(context.get(b"v22_completed_probe_count",0)==0)
 need(context.get(b"v23_completed_probe_count",0)==0)
 need(context.get(b"v22_probe_induction_trace",())==())
 need(context.get(b"v23_probe_induction_trace",())==())
 census=v26_probe_state_census(context)
 base_ids,transient_ids=census[1:3];probe_ids=set(base_ids+transient_ids)
 need(all(row[3]==b"CLOSED" and row[4]==-1 and row[11]==0 for row in census[3]))
 need(all(row[3]==b"CLOSED" and row[4]==-1 and row[11]==0 for row in census[4]))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED") and row[2]==-1 for row in census[5]))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") for row in census[6]))
 need(all(not row[1] and row[2] is None for row in census[7]))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"NO_WRAPPER",b"PROVED_CLOSED") and
  row[2] in (b"NO_CONSTRUCTOR",b"DETACH_CONFIRMED") for row in census[8]))
 need(all(all(raw[1] in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED") and raw[2]==-1 for raw in frame[12])
  for frame in census[9]))
 need(not any(row[0] in probe_ids for row in census[10]))
 need(all(row[1]==b"EMPTY" and row[2]==0 and row[3] is None and row[4] is None
  for row in census[11]))
 return (b"V26_NONE_EXHAUSTIVE_ZERO_HISTORY",census,
  tuple(row[0] for row in census[10]),(),0)

def v26_proof_digest(proof):
 need(type(proof)is tuple and proof[0]==V26_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG)
 raw=repr(proof).encode("ascii")
 return sha(b"P27_E001_V26_PROBE_PROOF\x00"+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\n"+raw)

def v26_repair_probe_compatibility(context,compatibility):
 try:
  tag,completed,facts,snapshot,turnover,pidfd_bound,close_state,offer_state=compatibility
  need(tag==b"V26_NONAUTHORITATIVE_PROBE_COMPATIBILITY")
  context[b"last_outer_pidfd_causal_facts"]=facts
  context[b"offer_snapshot_outer_fd"]=snapshot
  context[b"pidfd_bound"]=pidfd_bound
  context[b"outer_pidfd_close_state"]=close_state
  context[b"outer_pidfd_offer_state"]=offer_state
  context[b"outer_offer_binding"]=None
  context[b"v22_completed_probe_count"]=completed
  context[b"v23_completed_probe_count"]=completed
  context[b"v22_last_proved_turnover"]=turnover
 except BaseException:pass

def v26_closed_probe_snapshot(context,base_ids,transient_ids,capture):
 base_rows=tuple(v26_record_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index]) for index in base_ids)
 transient_rows=tuple(v26_record_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index]) for index in transient_ids)
 probe_ids=set(base_ids+transient_ids)
 raw_rows=tuple(v26_raw_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index].raw_cell)
  for index in base_ids+transient_ids)
 result_rows=tuple(v26_raw_row(WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index].raw_cell)
  for index in transient_ids)
 receive_rows=tuple(v26_frame_row(frame) for frame in WATCHDOG_V26_RECEIVE_FRAMES)
 poller_rows=tuple(v26_poller_row(cell) for cell in WATCHDOG_POLLER_CELLS_V19
  if cell.record_id in probe_ids)
 reconciliation=v26_reconciliation_rows(transient_ids)
 wrapper_rows=tuple((row[0],row[12],row[13],row[14],row[15],row[16],row[17],
  row[23],row[5],row[6],row[9],row[10]) for row in base_rows+transient_rows)
 physical_live=tuple(v26_record_row(record) for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED" or record.raw_fd>=0)
 receipts=tuple(v26_receipt_row(WATCHDOG_V26_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[index]) for index in base_ids)
 return (base_rows,transient_rows,raw_rows,result_rows,receive_rows,poller_rows,
  reconciliation,wrapper_rows,physical_live,receipts)

def v26_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,expected_record_id,expected_epoch):
 record_id,state,epoch,bound,terminal=receipt_row
 need(record_id==expected_record_id and epoch==expected_epoch and state==b"CLOSED_BOUND")
 need(type(bound)is tuple and len(bound)==18 and bound[0]==b"V26_TYPED_RECORD_BOUND_CLOSE_RECEIPT")
 need(bound[1]==record_id and bound[10]==epoch and bound[17] is True)
 need(terminal==(b"V26_TYPED_RECORD_CLOSE_EFFECT",record_id,epoch,b"CLOSED",-1,b"EMPTY",-1))
 return True

def v26_verify_outer_capture_receipt(capture,receipt_row):
 need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==16 and capture[0]==V26_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG)
 need(capture[1]==b"PREPARED_BEFORE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT")
 record_id,state,epoch,bound,terminal=receipt_row
 need(record_id==capture[2] and state==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and epoch==capture[14])
 need(v26_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,capture[2],capture[14]))
 need((bound[1],bound[2],bound[3],bound[4])==(capture[2],capture[3],capture[5],capture[7]))
 need((bound[5],bound[6],bound[7],bound[8],bound[9],bound[10])==
  (capture[8],capture[9],capture[10],capture[11],capture[13],capture[14]))
 need(bound[17] is True and bound[11] in (b"NO_WRAPPER",b"DETACHED",b"PROVED_CLOSED"))
 need(capture[13]==(b"PROMOTED",capture[12],capture[15],capture[14]))
 need(terminal==(b"V26_TYPED_RECORD_CLOSE_EFFECT",capture[2],capture[14],
  b"CLOSED",-1,b"EMPTY",-1))
 return True

def v26_logical_role_rows(arming_census,capture,history,ordinal):
 need(arming_census[0]==b"V26_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS")
 censuses=[]
 for event in history:
  if type(event)is tuple and event and event[0]==ordinal:
   for value in event:
    if type(value)is tuple and value and value[0]==b"V26_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS":censuses.append(value)
 censuses.append(arming_census)
 rows=[]
 for role in V26_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER:
  matches=[]
  for census in censuses:
   current=tuple(row for row in census[3] if row[2]==role and row[3] in (b"ACQUIRING",b"OWNED",b"CLOSE_RETRY") and row[4]>=0)
   need(len(current)<=1)
   if current:matches.append(current[0])
  need(matches);matched=matches[-1]
  rows.append((role,matched[0],matched[4],matched[5],matched[6],
   matched[9],matched[10],matched[11]))
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in rows)==V26_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER)
 outer=next(row for row in rows if row[0]==b"outer_pidfd")
 need((outer[1],outer[2],outer[3],outer[4],outer[5],outer[6],outer[7])==
  (capture[2],capture[7],capture[8],capture[9],capture[11],capture[13],capture[14]))
 return tuple(rows)

def v26_validate_reconciliation_rows(reconciliation,base_ids):
 for record_id,discovered,receipts in reconciliation:
  if not discovered:need(receipts is None);continue
  need(type(receipts)is tuple and receipts)
  for receipt in receipts:
   need(type(receipt)is tuple and len(receipt)==7 and receipt[0]==b"V23_RECONCILED")
   need(receipt[1]==record_id and receipt[2] in base_ids)
   need(type(receipt[3])is int and type(receipt[4])is tuple and len(receipt[4])==7)
   need(receipt[5] in (b"IDENTITY_MATCHED_ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_CLOSE",b"IDENTITY_SAFE_ORDINARY_CLOSE"))
   need(receipt[6] in (b"PRE_PLAN_PROBE_OR_ACTOR_PHASE",b"BEFORE_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE",b"AFTER_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE"))
 return True

def v26_verify_closed_snapshot(snapshot,base_ids,transient_ids,capture):
 base_rows,transient_rows,raw_rows,result_rows,receive_rows,poller_rows,reconciliation,wrapper_rows,physical_live,receipts=snapshot
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in base_rows)==base_ids)
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in transient_rows)==transient_ids)
 need(all(row[3]==b"CLOSED" and row[4]==-1 for row in base_rows+transient_rows))
 need(all(row[1]==b"DISARMED" and row[2]==-1 for row in raw_rows))
 need(all(row[1]==b"DISARMED" and row[2]==-1 for row in result_rows))
 need(all(all(raw[1]==b"DISARMED" and raw[2]==-1 for raw in frame[12])
  for frame in receive_rows))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") for row in poller_rows))
 need(v26_validate_reconciliation_rows(reconciliation,base_ids))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"NO_WRAPPER",b"PROVED_CLOSED") and row[7] is True and
  row[8] is None and row[9] is None
  for row in wrapper_rows))
 probe_ids=set(base_ids+transient_ids)
 need(not any(row[0] in probe_ids for row in physical_live))
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in receipts)==base_ids)
 for record_row,receipt_row in zip(base_rows,receipts):
  if record_row[11]==0:
   need(receipt_row[1]==b"EMPTY" and receipt_row[3] is None and receipt_row[4] is None)
  else:need(v26_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,record_row[0],record_row[11]))
 outer_receipts=tuple(row for row in receipts if row[0]==capture[2]);need(len(outer_receipts)==1)
 v26_verify_outer_capture_receipt(capture,outer_receipts[0])
 return (b"ALL_RECORD_PREDICATES_REVALIDATED",len(base_rows),len(transient_rows),
  len(raw_rows),len(result_rows),len(receive_rows),len(poller_rows),len(reconciliation))

def v26_verify_probe_proved(context,state,expected_ordinal=None):
 need(type(state)is tuple and len(state)==4 and state[0]==V26_PROBE_PROVED)
 proof,digest,compatibility=state[1:]
 need(type(proof)is tuple and len(proof)==22 and proof[0]==V26_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG)
 need(type(digest)is bytes and len(digest)==64 and v26_proof_digest(proof)==digest)
 ordinal,probe,completed=proof[1:4]
 need(type(ordinal)is int and 0<=ordinal<15 and probe==PROBES[ordinal] and completed==ordinal+1)
 if expected_ordinal is not None:need(ordinal==expected_ordinal)
 need(WATCHDOG_V26_OWNER_AUTHORITY.state is state)
 need(context.get(b"v26_owner_authority") is WATCHDOG_V26_OWNER_AUTHORITY)
 snapshot=v26_closed_probe_snapshot(context,proof[7],proof[8],proof[4])
 need(snapshot==proof[9]);need(v26_verify_closed_snapshot(snapshot,proof[7],proof[8],proof[4]))
 need(v26_logical_role_rows(proof[5],proof[4],proof[18],ordinal)==proof[11])
 need(compatibility==proof[20] and compatibility[1]==completed)
 return proof

def begin_probe_authority(context,ordinal,probe):
 need(type(ordinal)is int and 0<=ordinal<15 and probe==PROBES[ordinal])
 owner=v26_owner_authority(context);prior=owner.state
 if ordinal==0:
  need(prior[0]==V26_NONE);never=v26_probe_never_live_census(context)
  previous_proof=None;prior_digest=b"GENESIS";prior_history=()
 else:
  previous_proof=v26_verify_probe_proved(context,prior,ordinal-1)
  prior_digest=prior[2];prior_history=previous_proof[18]
  v26_repair_probe_compatibility(context,prior[3]);never=None
 census=v26_probe_state_census(context)
 history=prior_history+((ordinal,b"V26_BEGIN_PREPARED_BEFORE_PUBLICATION",prior_digest,census,never),)
 next_state=(V26_PROBE_ARMING,ordinal,probe,previous_proof,
  b"BEGIN_BEFORE_ANY_FALLIBLE_PROBE_WORK",None,census,history)
 owner.state=next_state
 return next_state

def v26_refresh_probe_authority(context,stage,state=V26_PROBE_ARMING):
 owner=v26_owner_authority(context);current=owner.state
 need(current[0] in (V26_PROBE_ARMING,V26_PROBE_ARMED))
 requested=V26_PROBE_ARMED if state in (V26_PROBE_ARMED,V25_PROBE_ARMED,V24_PROBE_ARMED) else V26_PROBE_ARMING
 prior_ids=current[6][1];capture=current[5]
 census=v26_probe_state_census(context,capture,prior_ids)
 history=current[7]+((current[1],stage,census),)
 next_state=(requested,current[1],current[2],current[3],stage,capture,census,history)
 owner.state=next_state
 return next_state

v24_refresh_probe_authority=v26_refresh_probe_authority

def promote_lifecycle_fd(context,old_slot,new_slot,new_kind,transferable=False,provenance=None):
 frame=context.get(b"v19_pending_receive_frame");source=context[b"fd_registry"][old_slot]

 owner=WATCHDOG_V27_OWNER_AUTHORITY
 prior=context.get(b"v27_owner_authority")

 return owner

def v27_probe_never_live_census(context):

 need(context.get(b"v22_completed_probe_count",0)==0)

 base_ids,transient_ids=census[1:3];probe_ids=set(base_ids+transient_ids)
 records=census[3]+census[4]
 need(all(row[2] is None and row[3]==b"CLOSED" and row[4]==-1 for row in records))
 need(all(row[5] is None and row[6] is None and row[7] is None and row[8] is None for row in records))
 need(all(row[9]==b"UNKNOWN" and row[10] is None and row[11]==0 for row in records))

 need(all(row[19]==b"EMPTY" and row[20]==-1 and row[22]==0 and row[23] is True for row in records))
 need(all(row[1]==b"EMPTY" and row[2]==-1 and row[4]==0 for row in census[5]))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") and row[2] not in probe_ids for row in census[6]))
 need(all(not row[1] and row[2] is None for row in census[7]))
 need(not any(row[0] in probe_ids for row in census[10]))

 frame_rows=[]
 for frame in WATCHDOG_V26_RECEIVE_FRAMES:
  associations=tuple((index,frame.expected_slots[index],frame.promoted[index],
   None if frame.records[index] is None else frame.records[index].record_id,
   v26_raw_row(frame.raw_cells[index])) for index in range(frame.installed_capacity))
  frame_rows.append((frame.site,frame.epoch,frame.installed_count,frame.payload_count,

   frame.cleanup_cursor,frame.cleanup_pending,associations))

 normalized=v26_normalize_closure_candidate(candidate)

 publication=(V27_OWNER_CLOSURE,detached_cell,image,normalized,prior)

 need(all(cell.state in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") for cell in WATCHDOG_POLLER_CELLS_V19))
 need(all(not frame.cleanup_pending and frame.cleanup_cursor==0 for frame in WATCHDOG_V26_RECEIVE_FRAMES))
 need(all(all(cell.state in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED") and cell.c_value.value==-1
  for cell in frame.raw_cells) for frame in WATCHDOG_V26_RECEIVE_FRAMES))
 need(all((not discovered) or WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset] is not None
  for offset,discovered in enumerate(WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED)))

def v27_owner_state_loop(context,prepared=None):
 owner=v27_owner_authority(context);pending=None
 if prepared is not None:
  prepared_owner,prior,publication=prepared
  need(prepared_owner is owner and owner.state is prior)
  need(publication[0]==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE and publication[1].phase==b"ACTIVE")
  need(publication[2][0]==V27_CLOSURE_IMAGE_TAG and publication[2][1] is publication[1])
  pending=publication
 retry=False
 while True:
  try:
   if retry:v27_positive_wait();retry=False
   if pending is not None:
    publication=pending
    owner.state=publication
   state=owner.state;mode=state[0]
   if pending is not None:need(state is pending);pending=None
   need(mode==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE)
   v27_repair_closure_compatibility(context,state)
   V27_NONPROBE_DRIVER_BASE(context,None,None,None,False)
   state=owner.state
   need(state[0]==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE and state[1].phase==b"RELEASED")
   v27_owner_release_exhaustive(context,state)
   raise V27_OWNER_RELEASE_HANDOFF
  except V27OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
  except BaseException:retry=True

def v27_takeover_owner_closure(context,acceptance_authority=None,offered=None):
 owner=v27_owner_authority(context)
 while True:
  try:
   state=owner.state
   if state[0]==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE:return v27_owner_state_loop(context)
   prepared=v27_prepare_closure_publication(context,acceptance_authority,offered)
   return v27_owner_state_loop(context,prepared)
  except V27OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
  except BaseException:
   if owner.state[0]==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE:return v27_owner_state_loop(context)
   v27_positive_wait()

def close_probe(context):

 if mode==V27_PROBE_PROVED:
  v26_verify_probe_proved(context,state);v26_repair_probe_compatibility(context,state[3]);return True
 if mode==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE:return v27_owner_state_loop(context)
 need(mode==V27_NONE);v27_probe_never_live_census(context);return True

def v27_prearm_acquisition_receipt(record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V27_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 fresh=receipt.epoch!=record.epoch
 if fresh:v27_reset_close_receipt(receipt,record.epoch)
 if receipt.state==b"EMPTY":
  receipt.bound=(b"V27_TYPED_ACQUISITION_EFFECT_RECEIPT",record.record_id,
   record.epoch,record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,record.identity,
   record.physical_identity,record.leaf_identity,record.access,record.provenance,
   record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.wrapper_ref is None,
   record.raw_cell.cell_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value)
  receipt.terminal=None;receipt.state=b"ACQUISITION_PREARMED"
 promotion=WATCHDOG_V27_PROMOTION_CELLS[record.record_id]
 if promotion.epoch!=record.epoch:v27_reset_promotion_cell(promotion,record.epoch)
 if fresh and watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record):
  offset=watchdog_v23_transient_offset(record)
  WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED[offset]=False
  WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]=None

 receipt.terminal=(V27_TYPED_CLOSE_TERMINAL_TAG,record.record_id,record.record_id,
  record.epoch,b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE",-1,-1,b"CLOSED",record.raw_cell.state,-1)

  (V27_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG,V27_PROMOTION_CAPTURE_TAG) and

def v27_frame_row(frame):

  frame.promoted[index],record_ids[index],

  raw_rows[index],record_rows[index]) for index in range(frame.installed_capacity))

  frame.installed_capacity,frame.installed_count,frame.payload_count,frame.msg_flags,
  frame.capture_complete,frame.validation_complete,frame.capture_fault,

def watchdog_record_reset_v19(record):

  receipt=WATCHDOG_V27_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
  if receipt.epoch==before_epoch and receipt.state==b"ACQUISITION_PREARMED":
   need(before_state in (b"ACQUIRING",b"CLOSED") and before_raw<0)
   v27_finish_never_live_receipt(record,receipt)
 return result

def v27_prepare_record_close_receipt(record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V27_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 if receipt.epoch!=record.epoch:v27_reset_close_receipt(receipt,record.epoch)
 if receipt.state in (b"EMPTY",b"ACQUISITION_PREARMED"):
  need(record.state!=b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd>=0)
  base_id=(record.provenance[1] if watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) and
   type(record.provenance)is tuple and len(record.provenance)>=2 else record.record_id)
  bound=(V27_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG,record.record_id,base_id,record.epoch,
   record.semantic_role,record.raw_fd,record.identity,record.physical_identity,
   record.leaf_identity,record.access,v27_effective_record_provenance(record),
   record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.wrapper_ref is None,
   record.raw_cell.cell_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value,
   record.raw_cell.epoch)
  need(bound[5]>=0 and bound[7] is not None and len(bound[7])==7)
  need(bound[9]!=b"UNKNOWN" and bound[10] is not None)
  receipt.bound=bound;receipt.terminal=None;receipt.state=b"CLOSE_ENTERED"
 else:
  need(receipt.state==b"CLOSE_ENTERED" and receipt.epoch==record.epoch)
  need(receipt.bound[1]==record.record_id and receipt.bound[5]==record.raw_fd)
 return receipt

def v27_finish_record_close_receipt(record,receipt,disposition):

 need(disposition in (b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF",b"ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_PHYSICAL_CLOSE"))
 need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
 terminal=(V27_TYPED_CLOSE_TERMINAL_TAG,record.record_id,receipt.bound[2],
  record.epoch,disposition,receipt.bound[5],-1,b"CLOSED",

  cell.acceptance_authority)==candidate[1:5])

  (candidate[6],candidate[7],0,-1))
 need(cell.preclose_done==candidate[8])
 need((cell.preclose_state,cell.preclose_send_latch,cell.preclose_packet,
  cell.preclose_packet_sha,cell.preclose_sequence,cell.preclose_deadline)==
  candidate[9])
 need(cell.epoch==candidate[11] and cell.release_handoff==candidate[12])
 return True

def v27_prepare_closure_publication_from_candidate(context,candidate):
 owner=v27_owner_authority(context);prior=owner.state
 need(prior[0] in (V27_NONE,V27_PROBE_ARMING,V27_PROBE_ARMED,V27_PROBE_PROVED))
 normalized=v27_normalize_closure_candidate(candidate)
 detached_cell=v27_build_detached_active_cell(normalized)
 v27_validate_detached_active_cell(detached_cell,normalized)
 image=v27_complete_closure_obligation_image(context,detached_cell,normalized,prior)
 publication=(V27_OWNER_CLOSURE,detached_cell,image,normalized,prior)
 need(publication[0]==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE and publication[1].phase==b"ACTIVE")
 need(publication[2][0]==V27_CLOSURE_IMAGE_TAG)
 return owner,prior,publication

def v27_repair_closure_compatibility(context,state):
 global CONTROL_SEND_SEQ,EXTERNAL_RECV_SEQ,WATCHDOG_ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORITY_V19
 need(state[0]==V27_OWNER_CLOSURE)
 cell,image,candidate=state[1:4]
 need(image[0]==V27_CLOSURE_IMAGE_TAG and image[1] is cell and image[2] is candidate)
 need(cell.phase in (b"ACTIVE",b"CLOSED",b"RELEASED"))
 context[b"v19_closure_cell"]=cell
 context[b"ownership_close_started"]=True
 context[b"ownership_close_mode"]=cell.mode
 CONTROL_SEND_SEQ=candidate[10]
 authority=candidate[4];commit=candidate[14]
 if authority is not None:
  EXTERNAL_RECV_SEQ=candidate[5]
  commit.authority=authority;commit.state=b"COMMITTED";commit.mode=authority[1]
  commit.offer_sha=authority[2];commit.record_seq=authority[3]
  commit.predecessor=authority[4];commit.receipt_sha=authority[5]
  commit.frozen_census_sha=authority[6];commit.current_census_sha=authority[7]
  commit.outer_record_id=authority[11];commit.outer_disposition=authority[12]
  commit.no_replay=authority[13];commit.commit_epoch=authority[14]
  context[b"external_record_seq"]=authority[3]
  context[b"external_chain_sha"]=authority[5]
  if cell.mode==b"GENERIC_ACCEPTED":
   context[b"transfer_receipt_sha"]=authority[5]
   context[b"transfer_acceptance_state"]=b"COMMITTED"
   context[b"transfer_capabilities_closed"]=False
   context[b"transfer_state"]=b"TRANSFER_ACCEPTED_CLOSURE_OWNER_PUBLISHED"
  else:
   need(cell.mode==b"REFUSAL_ACCEPTED")
   context[b"refusal_closure_sha"]=authority[5]
   context[b"refusal_offer_receipt_sha"]=authority[5]
   context[b"refusal_offer_complete"]=True
   context[b"refusal_acceptance_state"]=b"COMMITTED"
   context[b"refusal_capabilities_closed"]=False
   context[b"refusal_offer_state"]=b"ACCEPTED_CLOSURE_OWNER_PUBLISHED"
  if WATCHDOG_ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORITY_V19 is None:
   WATCHDOG_ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORITY_V19=authority
  else:need(WATCHDOG_ACCEPTANCE_AUTHORITY_V19 is authority)
 return True

def v28_receipt_row(receipt):
 return (receipt.record_id,)+receipt.authority

def v28_effective_record_provenance(record):
 cell=WATCHDOG_V28_PROMOTION_CELLS[record.record_id]
 capture=cell.capture
 if (cell.epoch==record.epoch and cell.state in
  (b"PREPARED",b"ROLE_COMMITTED",b"COMMITTED") and
  type(capture)is tuple and capture[0] in
  (V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG,V28_PROMOTION_CAPTURE_TAG) and
  record.semantic_role==capture[5]):
  return capture[13]
 return record.provenance

  v28_effective_record_provenance(record),record.epoch,record.endpoint_state,
  record.wrapper_phase,record.detached_raw_fd,record.wrapper_local_fallback,
  record.wrapper_probe_done,record.wrapper_detach_attempted,
  record.raw_cell.cell_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value,
  record.raw_cell.record_id,record.raw_cell.epoch,record.wrapper_ref is None,
  record.provenance)

 return (cell.cell_id,cell.state,cell.c_value.value,cell.record_id,cell.epoch)

def v28_reset_receipt_epoch(receipt,epoch):
 phase,old_epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 need(phase==b"EMPTY" and old_epoch==0 or phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND")
 receipt.authority=(b"EMPTY",epoch,None,None,None)

def v28_prearm_acquisition_receipt(record,kind=None,transferable=False,
 provenance=None):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V28_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 fresh_acquisition=(epoch!=record.epoch or phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND")
 if fresh_acquisition:
  v28_reset_receipt_epoch(receipt,record.epoch)
  phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 if phase==b"EMPTY":
  actual_provenance=record.provenance if provenance is None else provenance
  acquisition=(V28_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG,record.record_id,record.epoch,
   record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,kind,bool(transferable),actual_provenance,
   record.raw_cell.cell_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value,
   record.raw_cell.epoch)
  receipt.authority=(b"ACQUISITION_BOUND",record.epoch,acquisition,None,None)
 else:
  need(epoch==record.epoch and phase in
   (b"ACQUISITION_BOUND",b"CLOSE_PREPARED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING",
    b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",b"NORMALIZED_PENDING",b"CLOSED_BOUND"))
 promotion=WATCHDOG_V28_PROMOTION_CELLS[record.record_id]
 if fresh_acquisition or promotion.epoch!=record.epoch:
  need(promotion.state in
   (b"EMPTY",b"PREPARED",b"ROLE_COMMITTED",b"COMMITTED"))
  promotion.state=b"EMPTY";promotion.epoch=record.epoch
  promotion.capture=None;promotion.frame_row=None
 return receipt

def v28_close_bound(record,context,disposition_hint):
 effective=v28_effective_record_provenance(record)
 base_id=(effective[1] if watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) and
  type(effective)is tuple and len(effective)>=2 else record.record_id)
 slot=(None if watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) else
  watchdog_registry_slot_v19(context,record))
 endpoint_key=None if slot is None else LIFECYCLE_ENDPOINTS.get(slot)
 bound=(V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG,record.record_id,base_id,record.epoch,
  record.home_slot,record.semantic_role,disposition_hint,record.raw_fd,
  record.identity,record.physical_identity,record.leaf_identity,record.access,
  effective,record.endpoint_state,record.wrapper_phase,record.wrapper_ref is None,
  record.raw_cell.cell_id,record.raw_cell.state,record.raw_cell.c_value.value,
  record.raw_cell.epoch,slot,endpoint_key)
 need(bound[7]>=0 and bound[9] is not None and len(bound[9])==7)
 need(bound[11]!=b"UNKNOWN" and bound[12] is not None)
 return bound

def v28_prepare_record_close_receipt(record,context=None,
 disposition_hint=b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF"):
 receipt=v28_prearm_acquisition_receipt(record)
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 if phase==b"ACQUISITION_BOUND":
  close_bound=v28_close_bound(record,context,disposition_hint)
  receipt.authority=(b"CLOSE_PREPARED",record.epoch,close_bound,None,None)
 else:
  need(epoch==record.epoch and phase in
   (b"CLOSE_PREPARED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",
    b"NORMALIZED_PENDING",b"CLOSED_BOUND"))
  need(type(bound)is tuple and len(bound)==22 and
   bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG and bound[1]==record.record_id and
   bound[3]==record.epoch)
 return receipt

def v28_mark_effect_pending(receipt):
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 need(phase in (b"CLOSE_PREPARED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING"))
 pending=(b"V28_CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING",receipt.record_id,epoch,bound[7],bound[9])
 receipt.authority=(b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING",epoch,bound,pending,None)

def v28_mark_close_effect(receipt,disposition,observation):
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 need(phase in (b"CLOSE_PREPARED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING"))
 close_effect=(V28_CLOSE_EFFECT_TAG,receipt.record_id,epoch,disposition,
  observation,bound[7],bound[9])
 receipt.authority=(b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",epoch,bound,close_effect,None)

def v28_mark_never_live_effect(receipt):
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 need(phase==b"ACQUISITION_BOUND" and bound[0]==V28_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG)
 close_effect=(V28_CLOSE_EFFECT_TAG,receipt.record_id,epoch,b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE",
  b"NO_RAW_NUMBER_WAS_INSTALLED",-1,None)
 receipt.authority=(b"NEVER_LIVE_ENTERED",epoch,bound,close_effect,None)

def v28_finalize_closed_receipt(context,record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V28_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 need(epoch==record.epoch and record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
 if phase==b"EMPTY":
  need(epoch==0);return True
 if phase==b"ACQUISITION_BOUND":
  v28_mark_never_live_effect(receipt)
  phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 if phase in (b"CLOSE_PREPARED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING"):
  recovered=(V28_CLOSE_EFFECT_TAG,record.record_id,epoch,
   b"CLOSED_STATE_EFFECT_OBSERVED_NO_SYSCALL_RESULT_INVENTED",
   b"SAME_EPOCH_NORMALIZED_CLOSED_OBSERVATION",bound[7],bound[9])
  receipt.authority=(b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",epoch,bound,recovered,None)
  phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 if phase in (b"NEVER_LIVE_ENTERED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED"):
  V28_RECORD_RESET_BASE(record)
  receipt.authority=(b"NORMALIZED_PENDING",epoch,bound,effect,None)
  phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 if phase==b"NORMALIZED_PENDING":
  need(record.raw_cell.state in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED",b"RESOLVED_ALIAS",
   b"DETACHED",b"EFFECT_RESOLVED_BY_OBSERVATION"))
  record.raw_cell.c_value.value=-1
  slot=(bound[20] if bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG else bound[4])
  endpoint_key=(bound[21] if bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG else None)
  if context is not None and slot in LIFECYCLE_SLOT_SPEC_MAP:
   context[slot]=-1
   if endpoint_key is not None:context[endpoint_key]=None
   lifecycle_audit(context,slot,record)
  base_id=bound[2] if bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG else record.record_id
  raw_number=bound[7] if bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG else -1
  terminal=(V28_TYPED_CLOSE_TERMINAL_TAG,record.record_id,base_id,epoch,
   effect[3],raw_number,-1,b"CLOSED",record.raw_cell.state,-1,effect,bound)
  receipt.authority=(b"CLOSED_BOUND",epoch,bound,effect,terminal)
 else:
  need(phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and terminal[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_TERMINAL_TAG)
 return True

def watchdog_record_reset_v19(record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V28_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 if record.state!=b"CLOSED":
  need(epoch==record.epoch)
  if record.raw_fd<0 and phase==b"ACQUISITION_BOUND":
   v28_mark_never_live_effect(receipt)
   phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
  need(phase in (b"NEVER_LIVE_ENTERED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED"))
  result=V28_RECORD_RESET_BASE(record)
  receipt.authority=(b"NORMALIZED_PENDING",epoch,bound,effect,None)
  return result
 return V28_RECORD_RESET_BASE(record)

def v28_finish_never_live(context,record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V28_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority
 need(epoch==record.epoch and record.raw_fd<0)
 if phase==b"ACQUISITION_BOUND":v28_mark_never_live_effect(receipt)
 if record.state!=b"CLOSED":watchdog_record_reset_v19(record)
 return v28_finalize_closed_receipt(context,record)

def v28_finalize_all_closed_receipts(context):
 for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS:
  if record.state==b"CLOSED":
   v28_finalize_closed_receipt(None if
    watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) else context,record)
 return True

def lifecycle_begin_acquisition(context,slot,kind,transferable,provenance):
 record=None;started=False
 try:
  spec=watchdog_role_spec_v19(slot)
  need(spec[1]==kind and spec[2]==bool(transferable))
  record=context[b"fd_registry"][slot]
  need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
  v28_finalize_closed_receipt(context,record)
  watchdog_record_reset_v19(record);record.epoch+=1
  record.semantic_role=slot
  v28_prearm_acquisition_receipt(record,kind,transferable,provenance)
  record.state=b"ACQUIRING";started=True
  record.identity=None;record.physical_identity=None;record.leaf_identity=None
  record.verified_kill_leaf_identity=None;record.access=b"UNKNOWN"
  record.provenance=provenance;record.endpoint_state=b"NO_WRAPPER"
  record.wrapper_ref=None;record.detached_raw_fd=-1;record.wrapper_phase=b"NO_CONSTRUCTOR"
  record.wrapper_local_fallback=-1;record.wrapper_probe_done=False
  record.wrapper_detach_attempted=False
  cell=record.raw_cell;need(cell.state in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED"))
  cell.state=b"EMPTY";cell.c_value.value=-1;cell.record_id=record.record_id
  cell.epoch=record.epoch
  return record
 except V28OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
 except BaseException:
  if record is not None and started:
   if record.raw_fd<0:v28_finish_never_live(context,record)
   else:record.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY"
  raise

def watch_receive_prearm_v19(context,frame,received_slots,quarantine_slots):
 need(context.get(b"v19_pending_receive_frame") is None)
 need(frame.cleanup_cursor==0 and not frame.cleanup_pending)
 need(len(received_slots)<=frame.semantic_capacity and
  len(quarantine_slots)==frame.installed_capacity)
 frame.epoch+=1;frame.installed_count=0;frame.payload_count=0
 frame.msg_flags=0;frame.capture_complete=False;frame.validation_complete=False
 frame.capture_fault=b"NONE";frame.original_fault=None
 frame.immediate_checkpoint_done=False
 frame.hdr.msg_controllen=frame.kernel_control_bytes;frame.hdr.msg_flags=0
 ctypes.memset(ctypes.addressof(frame.control),0,frame.ancillary_bytes)
 for index in range(frame.installed_capacity):
  if index<len(received_slots):slot=received_slots[index][0];expected=slot
  else:slot=quarantine_slots[index-len(received_slots)];expected=None
  record=context[b"fd_registry"][slot]
  need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
  v28_finalize_closed_receipt(context,record)
  watchdog_record_reset_v19(record);record.epoch+=1
  record.semantic_role=slot
  v28_prearm_acquisition_receipt(record,LIFECYCLE_SLOT_SPEC_MAP[slot][0],
   LIFECYCLE_SLOT_SPEC_MAP[slot][1],frame.provenances[index])
  record.state=b"ACQUIRING"
  record.raw_fd=-1;record.identity=None;record.physical_identity=None
  record.leaf_identity=None;record.verified_kill_leaf_identity=None
  record.access=b"UNKNOWN";record.provenance=frame.provenances[index]
  record.endpoint_state=b"NO_WRAPPER";record.wrapper_ref=None
  frame.records[index]=record;frame.expected_slots[index]=expected
  frame.promoted[index]=False
  cell=frame.raw_cells[index];cell.state=b"EMPTY";cell.c_value.value=-1

class V28ReconciliationCell:

def v28_reconciliation_cell(record):

  need(phase in (b"EMPTY",b"TERMINAL"))

 WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]=projected

  else b"AFTER_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE")

   need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==19 and capture[0] in
    (V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG,V28_PROMOTION_CAPTURE_TAG))
   need(capture[2]==record_id and capture[4]==expected and
    capture[14]==record_epoch and capture[15]==(row[1],row[2],expected,record_id))
   binding=promotion_row[4]
   need(type(binding)is tuple and len(binding)==11)
   need(binding[:7]==(V28_PROMOTION_FRAME_BINDING_TAG,row[1],row[2],
    expected,record_id,record_epoch,b"PROMOTED"))
   need(binding[7][index] and binding[8][index]==record_id and
    binding[9][index]==expected and binding[10]==index)
  else:
   need(promotion_row[1] in (b"EMPTY",b"PREPARED",b"ROLE_COMMITTED"))
   if promotion_row[1]!=b"EMPTY":
    capture=promotion_row[3]
    need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==19 and
     capture[2]==record_id and capture[14]==record_epoch)
  if closed:
   need(record_row[3]==b"CLOSED" and record_row[4]==-1)
   need(raw_row[1] in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED",b"RESOLVED_ALIAS",
    b"DETACHED",b"EFFECT_RESOLVED_BY_OBSERVATION") and raw_row[2]==-1)
   need(receipt_row[1]==b"CLOSED_BOUND")
   need(v28_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,record_row))
   if installed:
    need(receipt_row[3][0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG and
     receipt_row[4][3] in (b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF",
      b"ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_PHYSICAL_CLOSE",
      b"CLOSED_STATE_EFFECT_OBSERVED_NO_SYSCALL_RESULT_INVENTED"))
   else:
    need(receipt_row[3][0]==V28_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG and
     receipt_row[4][3]==b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE")
   if installed and not promoted:
    need(outcome==b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_PROVED_CLOSED")
   if not installed:
    need(not promoted and outcome==b"NOT_INSTALLED_PROVED_NEVER_LIVE")
 return True

def v28_finalize_frame_promotion_history(frame):
 need(not frame.cleanup_pending and frame.cleanup_cursor==0)
 for index in range(frame.installed_capacity):
  record=frame.records[index]
  if record is None:continue
  cell=WATCHDOG_V28_PROMOTION_CELLS[record.record_id]
  if frame.promoted[index]:
   need(index<frame.installed_count and frame.expected_slots[index] is not None)
   need(cell.epoch==record.epoch and cell.state in
    (b"ROLE_COMMITTED",b"COMMITTED"))
   capture=cell.capture
   need(capture[2]==record.record_id and capture[4]==frame.expected_slots[index]
    and capture[14]==record.epoch and
    capture[15]==(frame.site,frame.epoch,frame.expected_slots[index],record.record_id))
   cell.frame_row=v28_promoted_frame_binding(frame,
    frame.expected_slots[index],record)
   cell.state=b"COMMITTED"
  else:need(cell.state in (b"EMPTY",b"PREPARED",b"ROLE_COMMITTED"))
 return True

def promote_lifecycle_fd(context,old_slot,new_slot,new_kind,transferable=False,
 provenance=None):
 owner=WATCHDOG_V28_OWNER_AUTHORITY;top=owner.state
 top_capture=(top[5] if type(top)is tuple and len(top)>=6 and
  type(top[5])is tuple and top[5][0]==V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG and
  top[5][1]==b"PREPARED_BEFORE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT" else None)
 if top_capture is not None:
  source=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[top_capture[2]]
  need(top_capture[4:7]==(old_slot,new_slot,new_kind))
  need(top_capture[16]==bool(transferable))
  frame_binding=top_capture[15];frame=None
  if frame_binding is not None:
   matches=tuple(item for item in V28_RECEIVE_FRAMES
    if item.site==frame_binding[0] and item.epoch==frame_binding[1])
   need(len(matches)==1);frame=matches[0]
 else:
  frame=context.get(b"v19_pending_receive_frame")
  source=context[b"fd_registry"][old_slot]
  if not watchdog_record_live_v19(source) and frame is not None:
   source=frame.record_for_expected(old_slot)
  frame_binding=None
 spec=watchdog_role_spec_v19(new_slot)
 need(watchdog_record_live_v19(source) and spec[1]==new_kind and
  spec[2]==bool(transferable))
 need(source.semantic_role in (old_slot,new_slot))
 need(not any(record is not source and watchdog_record_live_v19(record) and
  record.semantic_role==new_slot for record in WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19))
 cell=WATCHDOG_V28_PROMOTION_CELLS[source.record_id]
 existing=(cell.capture if cell.epoch==source.epoch and cell.state in
  (b"PREPARED",b"ROLE_COMMITTED",b"COMMITTED") else None)
 if top_capture is not None:
  need(existing is top_capture);capture=top_capture
 else:
  if frame is not None and frame.record_for_expected(old_slot,required=False) is source:
   frame_binding=(frame.site,frame.epoch,old_slot,source.record_id)
  if existing is None:
   prepared_provenance=provenance if provenance is not None else source.provenance
   need(prepared_provenance is not None)
   lifecycle_bind_identity_v19(source)
   need(source.identity==source.physical_identity and source.identity is not None)
   need(lifecycle_live_number_owner(context,source.raw_fd,old_slot) in
    (None,old_slot))
   for record in WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19:
    if record is not source and watchdog_record_live_v19(record):
     need(record.raw_fd!=source.raw_fd)
   promoted_provenance=(b"PROMOTED",prepared_provenance,frame_binding,source.epoch)
   capture_tag=(V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG if new_slot==b"outer_pidfd" else
    V28_PROMOTION_CAPTURE_TAG)
   capture=(capture_tag,b"PREPARED_BEFORE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT",
    source.record_id,source.home_slot,old_slot,new_slot,new_kind,source.raw_fd,
    source.identity,source.physical_identity,source.leaf_identity,source.access,
    prepared_provenance,promoted_provenance,source.epoch,frame_binding,
    bool(transferable),source.record_id,
    None if frame is None else v28_frame_row(frame))
   if cell.epoch!=source.epoch:
    cell.state=b"EMPTY";cell.epoch=source.epoch
    cell.capture=None;cell.frame_row=None
   cell.capture=capture;cell.frame_row=None;cell.state=b"PREPARED"
  else:capture=existing
 need(capture[2]==source.record_id and capture[3]==source.home_slot)
 need(capture[4:7]==(old_slot,new_slot,new_kind) and capture[7]==source.raw_fd)
 need(capture[8:12]==(source.identity,source.physical_identity,
  source.leaf_identity,source.access))
 need(capture[14]==source.epoch and capture[15]==frame_binding)
 need(source.provenance in (capture[12],capture[13]))
 if new_slot==b"outer_pidfd" and top_capture is None:
  current=owner.state
  need(current[0]==V28_PROBE_ARMING and current[2]==PROBES[current[1]])
  census=v28_probe_state_census(context,capture,current[6][1])
  history=current[7]+((current[1],b"V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_PREPARED_OLD_ROLE",
   capture,census),)
  owner.state=(current[0],current[1],current[2],current[3],
   b"V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_PREPARED_BEFORE_ROLE_COMMIT",capture,census,history)
 if source.semantic_role==old_slot:source.semantic_role=new_slot
 else:need(source.semantic_role==new_slot)
 cell.state=b"ROLE_COMMITTED"
 effective=capture[13]
 if source.provenance!=effective:source.provenance=effective
 source.state=b"OWNED"
 if frame_binding is not None:
  need(frame is not None);frame.mark_promoted(old_slot,source.record_id)
  cell.frame_row=v28_promoted_frame_binding(frame,old_slot,source)
 cell.state=b"COMMITTED"
 return source.raw_fd

def v28_validate_capture_frame_binding(capture,frame_rows):
 need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==19 and
  capture[0]==V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG)
 frame_binding=capture[15]
 need(type(frame_binding)is tuple and len(frame_binding)==4)
 need(frame_binding[2:]==(capture[4],capture[2]))
 cell=WATCHDOG_V28_PROMOTION_CELLS[capture[2]]
 need(cell.record_id==capture[2] and cell.epoch==capture[14])
 need(cell.capture is capture and cell.state==b"COMMITTED")
 committed=cell.frame_row
 need(type(committed)is tuple and len(committed)==11)
 need(committed[:7]==(V28_PROMOTION_FRAME_BINDING_TAG,frame_binding[0],
  frame_binding[1],frame_binding[2],frame_binding[3],capture[14],b"PROMOTED"))
 index=committed[10]
 need(committed[7][index] and committed[8][index]==capture[2] and
  committed[9][index]==capture[4])
 prepared=capture[18]
 need(type(prepared)is tuple and prepared[0]==V28_FRAME_ROW_TAG)
 prepared_matches=tuple(item for item in prepared[23]
  if item[2]==capture[4] and item[4]==capture[2])
 need(len(prepared_matches)==1)
 need(prepared_matches[0][1] and not prepared_matches[0][3])
 need(committed[1:3]==frame_binding[:2] and committed[5]==capture[14])
 need(type(frame_rows)is tuple and
  tuple(row[1] for row in frame_rows)==tuple(
   frame.site for frame in V28_RECEIVE_FRAMES))
 need(sum(1 for row in frame_rows if row[1]==frame_binding[0])==1)
 return True

# P27 RUNNER V28 EXHAUSTIVE PROBE PROOF BEGIN 28D4A904
V28_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG=b"V28_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF"

def v28_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,record_row):
 need(type(receipt_row)is tuple and len(receipt_row)==6)
 record_id,phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt_row
 need(record_id==record_row[0] and epoch==record_row[11])
 need(record_row[3]==b"CLOSED" and record_row[4]==-1)
 if epoch==0:
  need(phase==b"EMPTY" and bound is None and effect is None and terminal is None)
  return True
 need(phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and type(bound)is tuple)
 need(type(effect)is tuple and len(effect)==7 and
  effect[0]==V28_CLOSE_EFFECT_TAG and effect[1:3]==(record_id,epoch))
 need(type(terminal)is tuple and len(terminal)==12 and
  terminal[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_TERMINAL_TAG)
 need(terminal[1]==record_id and terminal[3]==epoch and
  terminal[6:8]==(-1,b"CLOSED") and terminal[10] is effect and
  terminal[11] is bound)
 if bound[0]==V28_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG:
  need(len(bound)==12 and bound[1:3]==(record_id,epoch))
  need(effect[3]==b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE" and terminal[2]==record_id and
   terminal[5]==-1)
 else:
  need(len(bound)==22 and bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG)
  need(bound[1]==record_id and bound[3]==epoch and bound[7]>=0)
  need(bound[9] is not None and len(bound[9])==7 and
   bound[11]!=b"UNKNOWN" and bound[12] is not None)
  need(terminal[2]==bound[2] and terminal[5]==bound[7])
 return True

def v28_probe_domain_ids(context,capture=None,prior_ids=()):
 domain=set(prior_ids)
 for record in WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19:
  if (record.home_slot in V28_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER or
   record.semantic_role in V28_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER):domain.add(record.record_id)
 if capture is not None:
  need(capture[0]==V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG);domain.add(capture[2])
 return tuple(sorted(domain))

def v28_probe_transient_ids(base_ids):
 rows=[]
 for record_id in base_ids:
  need(0<=record_id<len(WATCHDOG_PHYSICAL_RECORDS_V19))
  for cell,record in WATCHDOG_V22_WRAPPER_MATRIX[record_id]:
   rows.append(record.record_id)
 need(len(rows)==len(set(rows)));return tuple(rows)

def v28_probe_state_census(context,capture=None,prior_ids=()):

  for index in transient_ids)

  for index in base_ids+transient_ids)

  if cell.record_id in domain)

  row[17],row[23]) for row in base_rows+transient_rows)
 physical_live=tuple(v28_record_row(record)
  for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED" or record.raw_fd>=0)
 return (b"V28_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS",base_ids,transient_ids,base_rows,
  transient_rows,raw_rows,poller_rows,v28_reconciliation_rows(transient_ids),
  wrapper_rows,tuple(v28_frame_row(frame) for frame in V28_RECEIVE_FRAMES),
  physical_live,tuple(v28_receipt_row(WATCHDOG_V28_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[index])
   for index in base_ids+transient_ids),
  tuple(v28_promotion_row(WATCHDOG_V28_PROMOTION_CELLS[index])
   for index in base_ids))

def v28_verify_outer_capture_receipt(capture,receipt_row,frame_rows):
 need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==19 and
  capture[0]==V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG)
 need(capture[1]==b"PREPARED_BEFORE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT")
 record_id,phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt_row
 need(record_id==capture[2] and phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and epoch==capture[14])
 need(bound[0]==V28_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG)
 need(bound[1:4]==(capture[2],capture[2],capture[14]))
 need(bound[5]==capture[5] and bound[7]==capture[7])
 need(bound[8:13]==(capture[8],capture[9],capture[10],capture[11],capture[13]))
 need(terminal[1]==capture[2] and terminal[3]==capture[14])
 need(v28_validate_capture_frame_binding(capture,frame_rows));return True

def v28_verify_closed_snapshot(snapshot,base_ids,transient_ids,capture):
 (base_rows,transient_rows,raw_rows,result_rows,frame_rows,poller_rows,
  reconciliation,wrapper_rows,physical_live,receipts,promotions)=snapshot
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in base_rows)==base_ids)
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in transient_rows)==transient_ids)
 need(all(row[3]==b"CLOSED" and row[4]==-1
  for row in base_rows+transient_rows))
 need(all(row[1]==b"DISARMED" and row[2]==-1 for row in raw_rows))
 need(all(row[1]==b"DISARMED" and row[2]==-1 for row in result_rows))
 need(all(v28_validate_frame_row(row,True) for row in frame_rows))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"FREE",b"INACTIVE") for row in poller_rows))
 need(v28_validate_reconciliation_rows(reconciliation,base_ids,transient_ids))
 need(all(row[1] in (b"NO_WRAPPER",b"PROVED_CLOSED") and
  row[2] in (b"NO_CONSTRUCTOR",b"DETACH_CONFIRMED") and
  row[3]==-1 and row[4]==-1 and row[5] is False and row[6] is False and
  row[7] is True and row[8] is None and row[9] is None
  for row in wrapper_rows))
 probe_ids=set(base_ids+transient_ids)
 need(not any(row[0] in probe_ids for row in physical_live))
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in receipts)==base_ids+transient_ids)
 for record_row,receipt_row in zip(base_rows+transient_rows,receipts):
  need(v28_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,record_row))
 outer_receipts=tuple(row for row in receipts if row[0]==capture[2])
 need(len(outer_receipts)==1)
 need(v28_verify_outer_capture_receipt(capture,outer_receipts[0],frame_rows))
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in promotions)==base_ids)
 capture_rows=tuple(row for row in promotions if row[0]==capture[2])
 need(len(capture_rows)==1 and capture_rows[0][3] is capture and
  capture_rows[0][1]==b"COMMITTED")
 return (b"V28_ALL_RECORD_FRAME_RECEIPT_PREDICATES_REVALIDATED",
  len(base_rows),len(transient_rows),len(raw_rows),len(result_rows),
  len(frame_rows),len(poller_rows),len(reconciliation),len(receipts))

def v28_proof_digest(proof):
 need(type(proof)is tuple and proof[0]==V28_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG)
 raw=repr(proof).encode("ascii")
 return sha(b"P27_E001_V28_PROBE_PROOF\x00"+str(len(raw)).encode()+b"\n"+raw)

def v28_repair_probe_compatibility(context,compatibility):
 try:
  tag,completed,facts,snapshot,turnover,pidfd_bound,close_state,offer_state=compatibility
  need(tag==b"V28_NONAUTHORITATIVE_PROBE_COMPATIBILITY")
  context[b"last_outer_pidfd_causal_facts"]=facts
  context[b"offer_snapshot_outer_fd"]=snapshot;context[b"pidfd_bound"]=pidfd_bound
  context[b"outer_pidfd_close_state"]=close_state
  context[b"outer_pidfd_offer_state"]=offer_state
  context[b"outer_offer_binding"]=None
  context[b"v22_completed_probe_count"]=completed
  context[b"v23_completed_probe_count"]=completed
  context[b"v22_last_proved_turnover"]=turnover
 except V28OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
 except BaseException:pass

def v28_logical_role_rows(arming_census,capture,history,ordinal):
 need(arming_census[0]==b"V28_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS")
 censuses=[]
 for event in history:
  if type(event)is tuple and event and event[0]==ordinal:
   for value in event:
    if (type(value)is tuple and value and
     value[0]==b"V28_EXHAUSTIVE_PROBE_CENSUS"):censuses.append(value)
 censuses.append(arming_census);rows=[]
 for role in V28_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER:
  matches=[]
  for census in censuses:
   current=tuple(row for row in census[3] if row[2]==role and
    row[3] in (b"ACQUIRING",b"OWNED",b"CLOSE_RETRY") and row[4]>=0)
   need(len(current)<=1)
   if current:matches.append(current[0])
  need(matches);matched=matches[-1]
  rows.append((role,matched[0],matched[4],matched[5],matched[6],
   matched[9],matched[10],matched[11]))
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in rows)==V28_PROBE_ROLE_ORDER)
 outer=next(row for row in rows if row[0]==b"outer_pidfd")
 need((outer[1],outer[2],outer[3],outer[4],outer[5],outer[6],outer[7])==
  (capture[2],capture[7],capture[8],capture[9],capture[11],capture[13],capture[14]))
 return tuple(rows)

def v28_verify_probe_proved(context,state,expected_ordinal=None):
 need(type(state)is tuple and len(state)==4 and state[0]==V28_PROBE_PROVED)
 proof,digest,compatibility=state[1:]
 need(type(proof)is tuple and len(proof)==24 and
  proof[0]==V28_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG)

  completed==ordinal+1)
 if expected_ordinal is not None:need(ordinal==expected_ordinal)
 need(WATCHDOG_V28_OWNER_AUTHORITY.state is state)
 need(context.get(b"v28_owner_authority") is WATCHDOG_V28_OWNER_AUTHORITY)
 snapshot=v28_closed_probe_snapshot(context,proof[7],proof[8],proof[4])
 need(snapshot==proof[9])
 need(v28_verify_closed_snapshot(snapshot,proof[7],proof[8],proof[4])==proof[21])
 need(v28_logical_role_rows(proof[5],proof[4],proof[18],ordinal)==proof[11])
 need(compatibility==proof[20] and compatibility[1]==completed)
 need(proof[22]==b"ONE_RESUMABLE_TERMINAL_RECEIPT_PER_STARTED_EPOCH")
 need(proof[23]==b"PROMOTED_OR_UNPROMOTED_PROVED_CLOSED_EXHAUSTIVE")

def begin_probe_authority(context,ordinal,probe):
 need(type(ordinal)is int and 0<=ordinal<15 and probe==PROBES[ordinal])
 owner=v28_owner_authority(context);prior=owner.state
 if ordinal==0:
  need(prior[0]==V28_NONE);never=v28_probe_never_live_census(context)
  previous_proof=None;prior_digest=b"GENESIS";prior_history=()
 else:
  previous_proof=v28_verify_probe_proved(context,prior,ordinal-1)
  prior_digest=prior[2];prior_history=previous_proof[18]
  v28_repair_probe_compatibility(context,prior[3]);never=None
 census=v28_probe_state_census(context)

  prior_digest,census,never),)
 next_state=(V28_PROBE_ARMING,ordinal,probe,previous_proof,
  b"BEGIN_BEFORE_ANY_FALLIBLE_PROBE_WORK",None,census,history)
 owner.state=next_state;return next_state

  else V28_PROBE_ARMING)

 history=current[7]+((current[1],stage,census),)
 next_state=(requested,current[1],current[2],current[3],stage,current[5],
  census,history)
 owner.state=next_state;return next_state

def watchdog_v23_drain_new_mismatches(context,base):
 pending=False
 for record in watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(base):
  if v28_reconcile_transient(context,base,record)!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:
   pending=True
 for cell in WATCHDOG_V28_RECONCILIATION_CELLS:
  phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
  if phase==b"PREPARED" and bound[2]==base.record_id:
   record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[cell.record_id]
   if v28_reconcile_transient(context,base,record)!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:
    pending=True
 if watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(base):pending=True
 return V23_SAFE_HOLD_POSITIVE_WAIT if pending else V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED

 base_ids=current[6][1];transient_ids=current[6][2]
 for record_id in base_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]

   outcome=v24_close_one_probe_record(context,record)
