 for record_id in base_ids:
  base=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  while watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(base):
   if watchdog_v23_drain_new_mismatches(context,base)!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:
    v28_positive_wait()
 if v28_resume_prepared_reconciliations(context,transient_ids)!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:
  v28_positive_wait()
 for record_id in transient_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED":
   provenance=v28_effective_record_provenance(record)
   base_id=(provenance[1] if type(provenance)is tuple and
    len(provenance)>=2 else None)
   need(base_id in base_ids)
   if v28_reconcile_transient(context,
    WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[base_id],record)!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:
    v28_positive_wait()
 for record_id in base_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  if record.state!=b"CLOSED":v24_close_one_probe_record(context,record)
 WATCHDOG_OUT_STREAM_V19.reset();WATCHDOG_ERR_STREAM_V19.reset()
 for frame in V28_RECEIVE_FRAMES:
  watch_receive_cleanup_v19(context,frame)
  for record in frame.records:
   if record is not None and record.state==b"CLOSED":
    v28_finalize_closed_receipt(None if
     watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) else context,record)
  for cell in frame.raw_cells:
   need(cell.state in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED",b"RESOLVED_ALIAS",b"DETACHED",
    b"EFFECT_RESOLVED_BY_OBSERVATION"))
   cell.state=b"DISARMED";cell.c_value.value=-1
  v28_finalize_frame_promotion_history(frame)
 if v28_resume_prepared_reconciliations(context,transient_ids)!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:
  v28_positive_wait()
 for record_id in base_ids+transient_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
  v28_finalize_closed_receipt(None if
   watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) else context,record)
  record.raw_cell.state=b"DISARMED";record.raw_cell.c_value.value=-1
 need(not any(watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(
  WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[index]) for index in base_ids))
 return True

def v28_prepare_probe_proof(context,current):
 need(current[0]==V28_PROBE_ARMING)
 ordinal,probe=current[1:3];capture=current[5]
 need(capture is not None and capture[0]==V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG)
 base_ids=current[6][1];transient_ids=current[6][2]
 snapshot=v28_closed_probe_snapshot(context,base_ids,transient_ids,capture)
 predicates=v28_verify_closed_snapshot(snapshot,base_ids,transient_ids,capture)
 logical_roles=v28_logical_role_rows(current[6],capture,current[7],ordinal)
 facts=(capture[13][1],bool(context.get(b"pidfd_exit_ready_observed")),
  context.get(b"outer_release_record_identity"),context.get(b"outer_pid"),
  context.get(b"outer_starttime"))
 need(type(facts[2])is tuple and len(facts[2])==3)
 completed=ordinal+1;snapshot_reset=-1
 turnover=(b"V28_PROBE_TURNOVER_FROZEN",ordinal,facts,snapshot_reset,
  capture[2],b"PROVED_CLOSED")
 compatibility=(b"V28_NONAUTHORITATIVE_PROBE_COMPATIBILITY",completed,facts,
  snapshot_reset,turnover,False,b"CLOSED_NORMAL",b"NOT_BOUND")
 history=current[7]+((ordinal,b"V28_PURE_PROOF_PREPARED_ZERO_MUTATION",
  snapshot,predicates),)
 proof=(V28_PROBE_CLOSE_PROOF_TAG,ordinal,probe,completed,capture,current[6],
  current[3],base_ids,transient_ids,snapshot,facts,logical_roles,snapshot[0],
  snapshot[1],snapshot[2],snapshot[3],snapshot[4],current[3],history,
  snapshot_reset,compatibility,predicates,
  b"ONE_RESUMABLE_TERMINAL_RECEIPT_PER_STARTED_EPOCH",
  b"PROMOTED_OR_UNPROMOTED_PROVED_CLOSED_EXHAUSTIVE")
 need(len(proof)==24);digest=v28_proof_digest(proof)
 published=(V28_PROBE_PROVED,proof,digest,compatibility)
 return proof,digest,compatibility,published

def v28_probe_close_driver(context):
 owner=v28_owner_authority(context)
 while True:
  current=owner.state
  if current[0]==V28_PROBE_PROVED:
   v28_verify_probe_proved(context,current)
   v28_repair_probe_compatibility(context,current[3]);return True
  need(current[0] in (V28_PROBE_ARMING,V28_PROBE_ARMED))
  if current[0]==V28_PROBE_ARMED:
   current=v28_refresh_probe_authority(context,
    b"CLOSE_EFFECTS_RETAIN_EXACT_ARMING",V28_PROBE_ARMING)
  try:v28_close_probe_effects(context,current)
  except V28OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
  except BaseException:v28_positive_wait();continue
  try:prepared=v28_prepare_probe_proof(context,current)
  except V28OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
  except BaseException:v28_positive_wait();continue
  v28_publish_probe_proved_assignment_only(owner,current,prepared)
  v28_repair_probe_compatibility(context,prepared[2]);return True

  need(epoch==record.epoch and record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)

  need(record.raw_fd<0);v29_mark_never_live(receipt)

  (b"NEVER_LIVE_ENTERED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",b"NORMALIZED_PENDING"))

  b"MISMATCH_RETAINED",b"PREARMED"))

  effect[3],raw_number,-1,b"CLOSED",cell.state,-1,effect,bound)

 phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt.authority

   record.semantic_role,disposition_hint,bound[7],bound[8],bound[9],
   bound[10],bound[11],provenance,record.endpoint_state,

   bound[18],bound[19],bound[20],bound[21],bound[22])

def watch_receive_prearm_v19(context,frame,received_slots,quarantine_slots):
 need(context.get(b"v19_pending_receive_frame") is None)
 need(frame.cleanup_cursor==0 and not frame.cleanup_pending)
 need(len(received_slots)<=frame.semantic_capacity and
  len(quarantine_slots)==frame.installed_capacity)
 requests=[]
 candidate_frame_epochs=[]
 for index in range(frame.installed_capacity):
  if index<len(received_slots):slot=received_slots[index][0];expected=slot
  else:slot=quarantine_slots[index-len(received_slots)];expected=None
  record=context[b"fd_registry"][slot]
  receipt=WATCHDOG_V29_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
  acquisition=v29_authority_acquisition(receipt.authority[2])
  if (receipt.authority[0] in V29_ACTIVE_RECEIPT_PHASES and
   type(acquisition)is tuple and type(acquisition[12])is tuple and
   acquisition[12][0]==frame.site and acquisition[12][2:]==(index,expected)):
   candidate_frame_epochs.append(acquisition[12][1])
  requests.append((index,slot,expected,record))
 target_frame_epoch=(candidate_frame_epochs[0] if candidate_frame_epochs else
  frame.epoch+1)
 need(all(item==target_frame_epoch for item in candidate_frame_epochs))
 need(target_frame_epoch in (frame.epoch,frame.epoch+1))
 planned=[]
 for index,slot,expected,record in requests:
  kind,transferable=LIFECYCLE_SLOT_SPEC_MAP[slot]
  binding=(frame.site,target_frame_epoch,index,expected)
  target=v29_select_target_epoch(record,slot,kind,transferable,
   frame.provenances[index],binding)
  planned.append((index,slot,expected,record,target,kind,transferable,binding))
 for index,slot,expected,record,target,kind,transferable,binding in planned:
  v29_publish_target_acquisition(record,target,slot,kind,transferable,
   frame.provenances[index],binding)
 frame.epoch=target_frame_epoch;frame.installed_count=0;frame.payload_count=0
 frame.msg_flags=0;frame.capture_complete=False;frame.validation_complete=False
 frame.capture_fault=b"NONE";frame.original_fault=None
 frame.immediate_checkpoint_done=False
 frame.hdr.msg_controllen=frame.kernel_control_bytes;frame.hdr.msg_flags=0
 ctypes.memset(ctypes.addressof(frame.control),0,frame.ancillary_bytes)
 for index,slot,expected,record,target,kind,transferable,binding in planned:
  receipt=WATCHDOG_V29_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
  v29_resume_target_acquisition(record,receipt)
  frame.records[index]=record;frame.expected_slots[index]=expected
  frame.promoted[index]=False
  cell=frame.raw_cells[index];need(cell is record.raw_cell)
  cell.state=b"EMPTY";cell.c_value.value=-1
  cell.record_id=record.record_id;cell.epoch=record.epoch

def watch_receive_capture_one_v19(frame,index,number):

 record=frame.records[index];cell=frame.raw_cells[index]
 if number<0:
  frame.capture_fault=b"NEGATIVE_INSTALLED_RIGHT";return

  b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF",number)

 try:v29_bind_identity_under_authority(record,None)

  record.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY";cell.state=b"MISMATCH_RETAINED";raise

  cell.state=b"DISARMED";cell.c_value.value=-1
 if number>255 and receipt.authority[0]!=b"CLOSED_BOUND":
  record.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY";frame.capture_fault=b"FD_ABOVE_CACHED_BOUND"

def close_lifecycle_record_v19(context,record):

  v29_finalize_closed_receipt(context,record);return V23_CLOSE_PROVED
 need(record.raw_fd>=0)

 if receipt.authority[0]==b"CLOSED_BOUND":return V23_CLOSE_PROVED
 if receipt.authority[0] in (b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",b"NORMALIZED_PENDING"):
  v29_finalize_closed_receipt(context,record);return V23_CLOSE_PROVED

  record.wrapper_phase=V23_MISMATCH_DRAIN_PENDING

  if not v29_resume_pending_close_observation(receipt,record,context):
   return V23_CLOSE_PROVED

   if probe.errno==errno.EBADF:
    v29_mark_close_effect(receipt,b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF",
     b"SAME_RECORD_EBADF_OBSERVED_AFTER_CLOSE_ATTEMPT")

   raise OwnershipClosePending("v29-close-probe-unknown") from probe
  need(observed==bound[9])
  raise OwnershipClosePending("v29-close-live-retry") from error

  b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_RETURNED")

  v29_finalize_closed_receipt(None,record);return True
 if record.state in (b"ALIASED_ORIGINAL",b"ALIASED_REUSED"):
  owner_id=record.provenance[-2]
  owner=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[owner_id]
  need(owner is not record and owner.raw_fd==record.raw_fd and
   owner.physical_identity==record.physical_identity)
  v29_mark_close_effect(receipt,b"ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_PHYSICAL_CLOSE",
   b"EXACT_ALIAS_OWNER_RETAINED_NO_RAW_CLOSE")
  watchdog_v22_clear_transient_record(
   record,record.raw_cell,b"RESOLVED_ALIAS");return True
 need(watchdog_v22_transient_owns(record) or record.state==b"CLOSE_RETRY")
 record.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY";phase=receipt.authority[0]
 if phase==b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING":
  if not v29_resume_pending_close_observation(receipt,record,None):return True
 else:v29_mark_effect_pending(receipt)
 bound=receipt.authority[2]
 try:os.close(bound[7])
 except OSError as error:
  try:observed=lifecycle_identity(bound[7])
  except OSError as probe:
   if probe.errno==errno.EBADF:
    v29_mark_close_effect(receipt,b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF",
     b"SAME_RECORD_EBADF_OBSERVED_AFTER_TRANSIENT_CLOSE_ATTEMPT")
    watchdog_v22_clear_transient_record(
     record,record.raw_cell,b"DISARMED");return True
   raise OwnershipClosePending("v29-transient-close-probe-unknown") from probe
  need(observed==bound[9])
  raise OwnershipClosePending("v29-transient-close-live-retry") from error
 v29_mark_close_effect(receipt,b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF",
  b"PHYSICAL_TRANSIENT_CLOSE_RETURNED")
 watchdog_v22_clear_transient_record(record,record.raw_cell,b"DISARMED")
 return True
# P27 RUNNER V29 ATOMIC ACQUISITION AND CLOSE AUTHORITY END 29A1D701

# P27 RUNNER V29 RECEIVE FRAME AND RECONCILIATION AUTHORITY BEGIN 29B2E802
V29_RECONCILIATION_PREPARED_TAG=b"V29_TRANSIENT_RECONCILIATION_PREPARED"
V29_TYPED_RECONCILIATION_TAG=b"V29_TYPED_TRANSIENT_RECONCILIATION_RECEIPT"
V29_FRAME_ROW_TAG=b"V29_COMPLETE_RECEIVE_FRAME_ROW"
V29_PROMOTION_FRAME_BINDING_TAG=V28_PROMOTION_FRAME_BINDING_TAG
V29_RECEIVE_FAILURE_BOUNDARIES=(
 b"VALIDATION_FAILURE_BEFORE_PROMOTION_ONE",
 b"FAILURE_AFTER_PROMOTION_ONE_BEFORE_PROMOTION_TWO",
 b"FAILURE_AFTER_PROMOTION_TWO_BEFORE_PROMOTION_THREE",
 b"FAILURE_AFTER_PROMOTION_THREE",
)
WATCHDOG_V29_RECONCILIATION_CELLS=WATCHDOG_V28_RECONCILIATION_CELLS
V29_RECEIVE_FRAMES=V28_RECEIVE_FRAMES

def v29_reconciliation_cell(record):
 need(watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record))
 cell=WATCHDOG_V29_RECONCILIATION_CELLS[
  watchdog_v23_transient_offset(record)]
 need(cell.record_id==record.record_id);return cell

def v29_reset_reconciliation_cell(record):
 cell=v29_reconciliation_cell(record)
 phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
 if phase!=b"EMPTY" or epoch!=record.epoch:
  need(phase in (b"EMPTY",b"TERMINAL"))
  cell.authority=(b"EMPTY",record.epoch,None,None)
 offset=watchdog_v23_transient_offset(record)
 WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED[offset]=False
 WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]=None
 return cell

def v29_project_reconciliation_compatibility(cell):
 phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
 offset=cell.record_id-WATCHDOG_RECORD_COUNT_V19
 need(0<=offset<len(WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED))
 discovered=phase in (b"PREPARED",b"TERMINAL")
 projected=terminal if phase==b"TERMINAL" else None
 WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED[offset]=discovered
 WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]=projected
 return discovered,projected

def v29_reconciliation_phase(context,record):
 owner=WATCHDOG_V28_OWNER_AUTHORITY;state=owner.state
 if state[0]!=V28_OWNER_CLOSURE:return b"PRE_PLAN_PROBE_OR_ACTOR_PHASE"
 closure=state[1]
 return (b"BEFORE_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE" if record.record_id in closure.plan
  else b"AFTER_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE")

def v29_build_reconciliation_bound(context,base,record):
 receipt=WATCHDOG_V29_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
 if record.state!=b"CLOSED":
  hint=(b"ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_PHYSICAL_CLOSE" if record.state in
   (b"ALIASED_ORIGINAL",b"ALIASED_REUSED") else
   b"PHYSICAL_CLOSE_OR_SAME_RECORD_EBADF")
  v29_prepare_record_close_receipt(record,None,hint)
 phase,epoch,close_bound,effect,close_terminal=receipt.authority
 need(epoch==record.epoch and phase in
  (b"CLOSE_PREPARED",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_PENDING",b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",
   b"NORMALIZED_PENDING",b"CLOSED_BOUND"))
 if close_bound[0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG:
  need(close_bound[9] is not None and len(close_bound[9])==7 and
   close_bound[11]!=b"UNKNOWN")
  disposition=(b"IDENTITY_MATCHED_ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_CLOSE" if
   record.state in (b"ALIASED_ORIGINAL",b"ALIASED_REUSED") else
   b"IDENTITY_SAFE_ORDINARY_CLOSE")
 elif close_bound[0]==V29_PREIDENTITY_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG:
  need(phase in (b"CLOSE_EFFECT_OBSERVED",b"NORMALIZED_PENDING",
   b"CLOSED_BOUND") and effect[3]==b"PREIDENTITY_EBADF_PROVED_CLOSED")
  disposition=b"TYPED_PREIDENTITY_EBADF_CLOSED"
 else:need(False)
 discovery_phase=v29_reconciliation_phase(context,record)
 return (V29_RECONCILIATION_PREPARED_TAG,record.record_id,base.record_id,
  record.epoch,close_bound[7],close_bound[9],close_bound[11],
  close_bound[12],disposition,discovery_phase,v28_record_row(record),
  v28_record_row(base),v29_receipt_row(receipt))

def v29_reconcile_transient(context,base,record):
 cell=v29_reconciliation_cell(record)
 phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
 if phase==b"EMPTY":
  need(watchdog_v23_is_mismatch_for_base(base,record) or
   record.state==b"CLOSED")
  bound=v29_build_reconciliation_bound(context,base,record)
  cell.authority=(b"PREPARED",record.epoch,bound,None)
  watchdog_v22_close_transient(record)
 else:
  need(phase in (b"PREPARED",b"TERMINAL") and epoch==record.epoch)
  need(bound[0]==V29_RECONCILIATION_PREPARED_TAG and
   bound[1:4]==(record.record_id,base.record_id,record.epoch))
  if phase==b"PREPARED":watchdog_v22_close_transient(record)
 phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
 v29_project_reconciliation_compatibility(cell)
 if phase==b"TERMINAL":
  need(record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
  v29_finalize_closed_receipt(None,record)
  record.raw_cell.state=b"DISARMED";record.raw_cell.c_value.value=-1
  v29_project_reconciliation_compatibility(cell);return V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED
 need(phase==b"PREPARED" and record.state==b"CLOSED" and record.raw_fd==-1)
 v29_finalize_closed_receipt(None,record)
 close_receipt=v29_receipt_row(
  WATCHDOG_V29_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id])
 need(close_receipt[1]==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and
  close_receipt[2]==record.epoch)
 terminal=(V29_TYPED_RECONCILIATION_TAG,record.record_id,base.record_id,
  bound[3],bound[4],bound[5],bound[6],bound[7],bound[8],bound[9],
  close_receipt,bound[10],bound[11],bound[12],b"TERMINAL")
 cell.authority=(b"TERMINAL",record.epoch,bound,terminal)
 v29_project_reconciliation_compatibility(cell)
 record.raw_cell.state=b"DISARMED";record.raw_cell.c_value.value=-1
 return V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED

def v29_resume_prepared_reconciliations(context,transient_ids):
 pending=False
 for record_id in transient_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  cell=v29_reconciliation_cell(record)
  phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
  if phase==b"PREPARED":
   need(epoch==record.epoch)
   base=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[bound[2]]
   try:outcome=v29_reconcile_transient(context,base,record)
   except V28OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
   except BaseException:outcome=V23_SAFE_HOLD_POSITIVE_WAIT
   if outcome!=V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED:pending=True
  else:v29_project_reconciliation_compatibility(cell)
 return V23_SAFE_HOLD_POSITIVE_WAIT if pending else V23_MISMATCH_DRAINED

def v29_reconciliation_rows(transient_ids):
 rows=[]
 for record_id in transient_ids:
  record=WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS[record_id]
  cell=v29_reconciliation_cell(record)
  phase,epoch,bound,terminal=cell.authority
  offset=watchdog_v23_transient_offset(record)
  rows.append((record_id,phase,epoch,bound,terminal,
   WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_DISCOVERED[offset],
   WATCHDOG_V23_MISMATCH_RECONCILIATION[offset]))
 return tuple(rows)

def v29_validate_reconciliation_rows(reconciliation,base_ids,transient_ids):
 need(tuple(row[0] for row in reconciliation)==transient_ids)
 need(len(reconciliation)==len(set(row[0] for row in reconciliation)))
 seen=[]
 for record_id,phase,epoch,bound,terminal,compat_discovered,compat_receipt in reconciliation:
  if phase==b"EMPTY":
   need(bound is None and terminal is None and not compat_discovered and
    compat_receipt is None);continue
  need(phase==b"TERMINAL" and compat_discovered and
   compat_receipt is terminal)
  need(type(bound)is tuple and len(bound)==13 and
   bound[0]==V29_RECONCILIATION_PREPARED_TAG)
  need(bound[1]==record_id and bound[2] in base_ids and bound[3]==epoch)
  need(record_id not in seen);seen.append(record_id)
  need(type(terminal)is tuple and len(terminal)==15)
  need(terminal[0]==V29_TYPED_RECONCILIATION_TAG and
   terminal[1:10]==bound[1:10] and terminal[11:14]==bound[10:13] and
   terminal[14]==b"TERMINAL")
  receipt=terminal[10]
  need(receipt[0]==record_id and receipt[1]==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and
   receipt[2]==epoch)
  if bound[8]==b"TYPED_PREIDENTITY_EBADF_CLOSED":
   need(bound[5] is None and bound[6]==b"UNKNOWN")
   need(receipt[3][0]==V29_PREIDENTITY_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG and
    receipt[4][3]==b"PREIDENTITY_EBADF_PROVED_CLOSED")
  else:
   need(bound[8] in (b"IDENTITY_MATCHED_ALIAS_RETIRED_NO_CLOSE",
    b"IDENTITY_SAFE_ORDINARY_CLOSE"))
   need(bound[5] is not None and len(bound[5])==7 and
    bound[6]!=b"UNKNOWN")
   need(receipt[3][0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG)
  need(bound[9] in (b"PRE_PLAN_PROBE_OR_ACTOR_PHASE",
   b"BEFORE_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE",b"AFTER_IMMUTABLE_PLAN_FREEZE"))
 need(tuple(seen)==tuple(
  row[0] for row in reconciliation if row[1]==b"TERMINAL"))
 return True

def v29_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,record_row):
 need(type(receipt_row)is tuple and len(receipt_row)==6)
 record_id,phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt_row
 need(record_id==record_row[0] and epoch==record_row[11])
 need(record_row[3]==b"CLOSED" and record_row[4]==-1)
 if epoch==0:
  need(phase==b"EMPTY" and bound is None and effect is None and
   terminal is None);return True
 need(phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and type(bound)is tuple)
 need(type(effect)is tuple and len(effect)==7 and
  effect[0]==V29_CLOSE_EFFECT_TAG and effect[1:3]==(record_id,epoch))
 need(type(terminal)is tuple and len(terminal)==12 and
  terminal[0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_TERMINAL_TAG and
  terminal[1]==record_id and terminal[3]==epoch and
  terminal[6:8]==(-1,b"CLOSED") and terminal[10] is effect and
  terminal[11] is bound)
 if bound[0]==V29_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG:
  need(len(bound)==19 and bound[1:3]==(record_id,epoch))
  need(type(bound[18])is tuple and len(bound[18])==5 and
   bound[18][0] in (b"EMPTY",b"CLOSED_BOUND"))
  need(effect[3]==b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE" and terminal[2]==record_id and
   terminal[5]==-1)
 elif bound[0]==V29_PREIDENTITY_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG:
  need(len(bound)==23 and bound[1]==record_id and bound[3]==epoch)
  need(bound[7]>=0 and bound[8:12]==(None,None,None,b"UNKNOWN"))
  need(effect[3]==b"PREIDENTITY_EBADF_PROVED_CLOSED" and
   terminal[2]==bound[2] and terminal[5]==bound[7])
 elif bound[0]==V29_WRAPPER_OBSERVATION_BOUND_TAG:
  need(len(bound)==23 and bound[1]==record_id and bound[3]==epoch)
  need(bound[7]==-2 and bound[8:12]==(None,None,None,b"UNKNOWN"))
  need(effect[3]==b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE" and
   effect[4]==b"WRAPPER_OPERATION_RETURNED_NO_RIGHT")
 else:
  need(len(bound)==23 and bound[0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG)
  need(bound[1]==record_id and bound[3]==epoch and bound[7]>=0)
  need(bound[9] is not None and len(bound[9])==7 and
   bound[11]!=b"UNKNOWN" and bound[12] is not None)
  need(terminal[2]==bound[2] and terminal[5]==bound[7])
 return True

def v29_frame_row(frame):
 raw_rows=tuple(v28_raw_row(cell) for cell in frame.raw_cells)
 record_rows=tuple(None if record is None else v28_record_row(record)
  for record in frame.records)
 record_ids=tuple(None if record is None else record.record_id
  for record in frame.records)
 promotion_rows=tuple(None if record is None else
  v28_promotion_row(WATCHDOG_V29_PROMOTION_CELLS[record.record_id])
  for record in frame.records)
 receipt_rows=tuple(None if record is None else
  v29_receipt_row(WATCHDOG_V29_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id])
  for record in frame.records)
 associations=[]
 for index in range(frame.installed_capacity):
  installed=index<frame.installed_count;promoted=frame.promoted[index]
  record_row=record_rows[index];receipt_row=receipt_rows[index]
  if record_row is None:outcome=b"NO_RECORD"
  elif promoted:outcome=b"PROMOTED_INTO_CAPTURED_OWNER"
  elif installed and receipt_row[1]==b"CLOSED_BOUND":
   if receipt_row[3][0]==V29_PREIDENTITY_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG:
    outcome=b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_PREIDENTITY_EBADF_CLOSED"
   else:outcome=b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_IDENTIFIED_CLOSED"
  elif not installed and receipt_row[1]==b"CLOSED_BOUND":
   outcome=b"NOT_INSTALLED_PROVED_NEVER_LIVE"
  else:outcome=b"UNPROMOTED_PENDING_CLEANUP"
  associations.append((index,installed,frame.expected_slots[index],promoted,
   record_ids[index],None if record_row is None else record_row[11],
   raw_rows[index],record_row,promotion_rows[index],receipt_row,outcome))
 return (V29_FRAME_ROW_TAG,frame.site,frame.epoch,frame.semantic_capacity,
  frame.installed_capacity,frame.installed_count,frame.payload_count,
  frame.msg_flags,frame.capture_complete,frame.validation_complete,
  frame.capture_fault,frame.cleanup_cursor,frame.cleanup_pending,
  frame.original_fault,frame.immediate_checkpoint_done,raw_rows,record_ids,
  record_rows,tuple(frame.expected_slots),tuple(frame.promoted),
  tuple(frame.provenances),promotion_rows,receipt_rows,tuple(associations))

def v29_validate_frame_row(row,closed=False):
 need(type(row)is tuple and len(row)==24 and row[0]==V29_FRAME_ROW_TAG)
 installed_capacity=row[4];installed_count=row[5]
 need(0<=installed_count<=installed_capacity)
 need(len(row[15])==len(row[16])==len(row[17])==len(row[18])==
  len(row[19])==len(row[20])==len(row[21])==len(row[22])==
  len(row[23])==installed_capacity)
 if closed:need(row[12] is False and row[11]==0)
 for index,association in enumerate(row[23]):
  (position,installed,expected,promoted,record_id,record_epoch,raw_row,
   record_row,promotion_row,receipt_row,outcome)=association
  need(position==index and installed==(index<installed_count))
  need(expected==row[18][index] and promoted is row[19][index])
  need(record_id==row[16][index] and raw_row==row[15][index])
  need(record_row==row[17][index] and promotion_row==row[21][index])
  need(receipt_row==row[22][index])
  if record_row is None:
   need(not installed and not promoted and record_id is None and
    promotion_row is None and receipt_row is None and outcome==b"NO_RECORD")
   continue
  need(record_id==record_row[0] and record_epoch==record_row[11])
  need(promotion_row[0]==record_id and promotion_row[2]==record_epoch)
  need(receipt_row[0]==record_id and receipt_row[2]==record_epoch)
  if promoted:
   need(installed and expected is not None and
    outcome==b"PROMOTED_INTO_CAPTURED_OWNER")
   need(promotion_row[1]==b"COMMITTED")
   capture=promotion_row[3]
   need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==19 and capture[0] in
    (V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG,V28_PROMOTION_CAPTURE_TAG))
   need(capture[2]==record_id and capture[4]==expected and
    capture[14]==record_epoch and
    capture[15]==(row[1],row[2],expected,record_id))
   binding=promotion_row[4]
   need(type(binding)is tuple and len(binding)==11 and
    binding[1:7]==(row[1],row[2],expected,record_id,record_epoch,b"PROMOTED"))
   need(binding[7][index] and binding[8][index]==record_id and
    binding[9][index]==expected and binding[10]==index)
  else:
   need(promotion_row[1] in (b"EMPTY",b"PREPARED",b"ROLE_COMMITTED"))
  if closed:
   need(record_row[3]==b"CLOSED" and record_row[4]==-1)
   need(raw_row[1] in (b"EMPTY",b"DISARMED",b"RESOLVED_ALIAS",
    b"DETACHED",b"EFFECT_RESOLVED_BY_OBSERVATION") and raw_row[2]==-1)
   need(receipt_row[1]==b"CLOSED_BOUND")
   need(v29_verify_typed_close_receipt(receipt_row,record_row))
   if promoted:
    need(receipt_row[3][0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG)
   elif installed and receipt_row[3][0]==V29_PREIDENTITY_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG:
    need(outcome==b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_PREIDENTITY_EBADF_CLOSED" and
     receipt_row[4][3]==b"PREIDENTITY_EBADF_PROVED_CLOSED")
   elif installed:
    need(outcome==b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_IDENTIFIED_CLOSED" and
     receipt_row[3][0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG and
     receipt_row[3][9] is not None and receipt_row[3][11]!=b"UNKNOWN")
   else:
    need(not promoted and outcome==b"NOT_INSTALLED_PROVED_NEVER_LIVE" and
     receipt_row[3][0]==V29_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG and
     receipt_row[4][3]==b"PROVED_NEVER_LIVE")
 if closed:v29_validate_receive_failure_partition(row)
 return True

def v29_validate_receive_failure_partition(row):
 need(type(row)is tuple and len(row)==24 and row[0]==V29_FRAME_ROW_TAG)
 promoted_count=sum(1 for item in row[23] if item[3])
 need(0<=promoted_count<=row[5])
 for association in row[23]:
  installed=association[1];promoted=association[3];outcome=association[10]
  need((promoted and outcome==b"PROMOTED_INTO_CAPTURED_OWNER") or
   (installed and not promoted and outcome in
    (b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_IDENTIFIED_CLOSED",
     b"INSTALLED_UNPROMOTED_PREIDENTITY_EBADF_CLOSED")) or
   (not installed and not promoted and outcome in
    (b"NOT_INSTALLED_PROVED_NEVER_LIVE",b"NO_RECORD")))
 return (V29_RECEIVE_FAILURE_BOUNDARIES,
  min(promoted_count,len(V29_RECEIVE_FAILURE_BOUNDARIES)-1))

def v29_verify_outer_capture_receipt(capture,receipt_row,frame_rows):
 need(type(capture)is tuple and len(capture)==19 and
  capture[0]==V28_OUTER_CAPTURE_TAG)
 need(capture[1]==b"PREPARED_BEFORE_SEMANTIC_ROLE_ASSIGNMENT")
 record_id,phase,epoch,bound,effect,terminal=receipt_row
 need(record_id==capture[2] and phase==b"CLOSED_BOUND" and
  epoch==capture[14])
 need(bound[0]==V29_TYPED_CLOSE_BOUND_TAG and
  bound[1:4]==(capture[2],capture[2],capture[14]))
 need(bound[5]==capture[5] and bound[7]==capture[7])
 need(bound[8:12]==(
  capture[8],capture[9],capture[10],capture[11]))
 need(bound[12]==capture[13])
 need(bound[22][0]==V29_TYPED_ACQUISITION_BOUND_TAG and
  bound[22][4]==capture[4] and bound[22][7]==capture[12])
 need(terminal[1]==capture[2] and terminal[3]==capture[14])
 need(v28_validate_capture_frame_binding(capture,frame_rows));return True

def v29_finalize_all_closed_receipts(context):
 for record in WATCHDOG_V22_ALL_PHYSICAL_RECORDS:
  if record.state==b"CLOSED":
   receipt=WATCHDOG_V29_CLOSE_RECEIPTS[record.record_id]
   if receipt.authority[0] not in (b"EMPTY",b"CLOSED_BOUND"):
    v29_finalize_closed_receipt(None if
     watchdog_v22_transient_physical(record) else context,record)
 return True

def watchdog_v23_drain_one_mismatch(context,base,record):
 return v29_reconcile_transient(context,base,record)

def watchdog_v23_drain_new_mismatches(context,base):
 initial=watchdog_v23_live_mismatch_records(base)
 prepared=tuple(cell for cell in WATCHDOG_V29_RECONCILIATION_CELLS
  if cell.authority[0]==b"PREPARED" and
  cell.authority[2][2]==base.record_id)
 requested=(base.wrapper_phase==V23_MISMATCH_DRAIN_PENDING or
  bool(initial) or bool(prepared))
 if requested:
  base.state=b"CLOSE_RETRY";base.wrapper_phase=V23_MISMATCH_DRAIN_PENDING
 pending=False
 for record in initial:
  try:outcome=v29_reconcile_transient(context,base,record)
  except V28OwnerReleaseHandoff:raise
